The Lukoil portfolio, initially valued at about $22 billion, had attracted interest from at least a dozen companies including Exxon Mobil (XOM.N) and the former owner of Pornhub, Bernd Bergmair.

item.title: PETA urges Crystal Palace to retire bald eagle mascot Phoenix
item.description: Animal rights group PETA has urged Crystal Palace to retire its American bald eagle mascot, Phoenix, saying football stadiums are unsuitable environments that can distress birds and potentially put them and spectators at risk.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Animal rights group PETA has urged Crystal Palace to retire its American bald eagle mascot, Phoenix, saying football stadiums are unsuitable environments that can distress birds and potentially put them and spectators at risk. Palace, known as the Eagles since 1973, introduced a live eagle as a matchday mascot in 2010. Phoenix made her official debut in August 2024 at four months old, succeeding long-serving mascot Kayla, who died in 2020. In a letter to Palace CEO Sharon Lacey, People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals cited incidents involving birds at sporting events, including one in which a Charlton Athletic fan was found guilty of attempting to punch Kayla at a 2015 League Cup match. "A bright stadium filled with boisterous fans is no place for animals. Under such conditions, birds easily become frightened, disoriented, and panicked - placing themselves and others at risk...," PETA wrote. "When eagles are used for displays and entertainment, they are denied the opportunity to engage in their natural behaviour, resulting in frustration and stress. Wildlife doesn't belong in a football stadium... "Bald eagles are widely recognised as symbols of freedom. They deserve better than to be used as an entertainment 'prop' to amuse The Eagles' fans. "PETA urges Crystal Palace FC to protect animals by retiring Phoenix and committing never to use a live animal mascot again." Palace has not responded to a Reuters request for comment. PETA said no other UK football club still uses a live animal mascot. Some other European clubs have used live eagle mascots, including Portuguese side Benfica and Italian club Lazio.

item.title: Kenya seals $160 million conservation finance deal
item.description: Kenya's government and a group of donors have signed a $160 million conservation programme aimed at protecting 173,000 square km (17.3 million hectares) of some of the most complex and least disturbed natural environments on Earth.
item.dc:creator: Marc Jones
item.content:encoded: Kenya's government and a group of donors have signed a $160 million conservation programme aimed at protecting 173,000 square km (17.3 million hectares) of some of the most complex and least disturbed natural environments on Earth. The Thamani Asili initiative, which means "value of nature" in Kiswahili, will focus on key biodiversity hotspots from the Great Rift Valley to the Maasai Mara which are home to thousands of elephants, rhinos, lions and other species. Details on Wednesday showed it will combine $80 million from dozens of donors including billionaire heirs of the Walton and Cargill families, with a similar amount from the Kenyan government over the next 10 years. The money aims to fund new conservation areas and improve management of some existing ones using a "Project Finance for Permanence" (PFP) model, which binds funding to key government policy changes. Kenya's Cabinet Secretary for Tourism and Wildlife, Rebecca Miano, said it would both protect the country's wildlife and help farmers and communities that share the landscapes. A recent UN Environment Programme report cited past government estimates that around 42% of Kenya's GDP and 70% of employment in the country depends on nature in one form or another. Kenya's environmental credentials have been thrust into the spotlight in recent weeks after President William Ruto and Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, [USN:L8N45L1OV TEXT:"broke ground"] on a new $16 billion dollar oil refinery being built on the country's coast. The PFP model is gaining popularity. Brazil and Gabon both announced similar agreements last year, while others are in the works in both Namibia and Botswana. Ruth Masha at The Nature Conservancy, which helped put together the plan, said it would initially focus on four key regions. One of them, Tsavo, is home to the country's largest national parks, 40% of its elephants and 20% of its critically endangered black rhinos. Another in the south along the border with Tanzania includes the Maasai Mara national reserve and connects into the Serengeti. It is also set to get the government closer to the global target to protect 30% of land and sea for nature by 2030. TNC estimates Kenya is currently at around 20%-23%. "There is a substantial gap that would be largely closed," the head of TNC's PFP programme, Ryan Bidwell, said.

item.title: Yankees GM Brian Cashman agrees to contract, to return for 30th season
item.description: New York Yankees general manager Brian Cashman and the team have agreed to a new contract, allowing him to return to the role for a 30th season in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Yankees general manager Brian Cashman and the team have agreed to a new contract, allowing him to return to the role for a 30th season in 2027. Cashman, 59, announced his own re-signing on Wednesday in a video news conference. He did not reveal any contract terms, but his current deal was set to expire this fall. "We've agreed on a new contract that we just have to bang out some minor stuff on the back end of it, but we're locked and loaded," Cashman said. Cashman was just 31 when the late George Steinbrenner, who was known for churning through managers and general managers, promoted him -- and kept him in the job. His first significant trade came Feb. 6, 1998, when he sent future All-Star shortstop Cristian Guzman and three prospects to the Minnesota Twins for infielder Chuck Knoblauch. During Cashman's tenure, the Yankees have never had a losing season. They have won four World Series, seven American League pennants and 15 AL East titles. Nine of those came consecutively in Cashman's first nine seasons, with Joe Torre as the field manager. In Cashman's 29 seasons, the Yankees have failed to qualify for the postseason just five times. But the Yankees have not won the World Series since 2009, leading to some disgruntlement among fans. Still, Cashman enjoys the support of owner Hal Steinbrenner, who spoke favorably of both Cashman and manager Aaron Boone. "Cash is great every season," Steinbrenner said on the video call from Tampa, Fla., where he sat with Cashman at team facilities. "I mean, I think the roster he put together, the team that we rolled out of spring training with, was as good as any in baseball, in my opinion. "We had a lot of bumps and bruises along the way, but the team was fantastic. And I thought it was a world championship team. "Talking about this season, I thought Boone managed a good season, especially with the pitching staff. We had a lot of additions and subtractions in the rotation throughout the course of the season. Our bullpen was absolutely exhausted by the end of the season. He got through all that and he got us to the playoffs." But the players didn't do their jobs, he said. "The bottom line is, the players didn't live up to their end of the bargain in the playoffs," he said. "So I thought (Boone) had a good season." Boone is expected to remain the manager of the Yankees, who finished 93-68 and defeated the Boston Red Sox in the wild-card round before losing to the Tampa Bay Rays in the American League Division Series. --Field Level Media

item.title: El rendimiento de los bonos franceses alcanza el 5%, su nivel más alto desde 2002
item.description: El aumento de los precios de la energía y las dudas sobre la capacidad del Gobierno para aprobar un presupuesto que aborde la deuda pública impulsan los rendimientos de los bonos franceses.
item.dc:creator: Alice Atkins
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — La rentabilidad de la deuda francesa de referencia alcanzó el 5% por primera vez desde 2002, a medida que el aumento de los precios de la energía exacerbó la preocupación por las perspectivas fiscales del país. Los bonos gubernamentales con vencimiento a 10 años retrocedieron el miércoles, lo que provocó un aumento de siete puntos básicos en su rendimiento. Esto contribuyó a ampliar la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos franceses y alemanes a 159,4 puntos básicos, la mayor en 15 años. Ver más: Francia admite fallos de inteligencia tras subestimar la magnitud de las protestas Considerado un indicador clave del riesgo crediticio en la zona euro, el diferencial ha aumentado drásticamente desde finales de septiembre, a medida que se cuestiona cada vez más la capacidad de Francia para aprobar un presupuesto que aborde su carga de deuda. La indignación pública por el coste de la vida degeneró en violentas protestas durante el fin de semana. “Es probable que los diferenciales sigan bajo presión a medida que la atención se centra de nuevo en las próximas votaciones presupuestarias”, declaró Pooja Kumra, estratega sénior de tipos de interés para el Reino Unido y Europa en el Toronto Dominion Bank. “Incluso si se aprueba el presupuesto, a los inversores les siguen preocupando los indicios generales de disfunción fiscal y fragmentación política”. El miércoles, el alza de los precios de la energía impulsó la evolución de los bonos europeos, con los futuros de referencia del gas natural europeo subiendo alrededor de un 4% y el petróleo crudo Brent cotizando cerca de los 110 dólares por barril. En declaraciones realizadas a primera hora del día, el consejero delegado de Deutsche Bank AG, Christian Sewing, destacó la inestabilidad fiscal y política en Francia como motivo de preocupación , y señaló que es probable que la volatilidad continúe hasta las elecciones presidenciales del próximo año. Ver más: Macron acusa a líderes extranjeros de aprovecharse de los disturbios en Francia “Unos mayores rendimientos de la deuda soberana global también perjudicarían a los bonos franceses, dada su mayor sensibilidad a las fluctuaciones de sus pares. Preveo que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense y de los bonos alemanes a largo plazo aumentarán debido al gasto deficitario y la inflación descontrolada, lo que deja a los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense especialmente vulnerables”. — Ven Ram, estratega de activos múltiples. Ver más: Los disturbios en Francia pierden fuerza tras el endurecimiento de las medidas de seguridad El euro tuvo un rendimiento inferior al de la mayoría de las monedas del Grupo de los 10 frente al dólar, llegando a caer hasta un 0,2%, situándose en 1,1214 dólares. El Parlamento francés está profundamente dividido, y alcanzar un compromiso sobre el presupuesto del próximo año que permita la aprobación de los proyectos de ley está resultando una tarea ardua. A tan solo seis meses de las elecciones presidenciales, es poco probable que el proceso se simplifique. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Líder supremo de Irán, Jamenei, se reúne con presidente del Parlamento, según cadena estatal IRIB
item.description: El líder supremo de Irán, Mojtaba Jamenei, se ha reunido con el presidente del Parlamento, Mohammed Baqer Qalibaf, y ha analizado la evolución de la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Israel, según informó el miércoles la cadena estatal IRIB.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El líder supremo de Irán, Mojtaba Jamenei, se ha reunido con el presidente del Parlamento, Mohammed Baqer Qalibaf, y ha analizado la evolución de la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Israel, según informó el miércoles la cadena estatal IRIB. Jamenei, quien según fuentes de alto rango sufrió desfiguraciones faciales y otras lesiones en un ataque aéreo, no ha aparecido en público ante los iraníes desde que fue nombrado líder supremo el 8 de marzo.

item.title: Saints first-rounder Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) not ready, could debut Week 9
item.description: New Orleans Saints first-round pick Jordyn Tyson is not ready to make his NFL debut in Paris this week, but general manager Mickey Loomis sprinkled a bit of optimism regarding the near-term outlook for the wide receiver.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Orleans Saints first-round pick Jordyn Tyson is not ready to make his NFL debut in Paris this week, but general manager Mickey Loomis sprinkled a bit of optimism regarding the near-term outlook for the wide receiver. Drafted eighth overall out of Arizona State, Tyson has not practiced since injuring his hamstring Aug. 13 in a joint practice with the Jacksonville Jaguars. His pre-draft standing with some teams was impacted by a history of soft-tissue injuries. He wasn't available for timing and agility tests prior to the draft, also because of a hamstring injury. Loomis said the current hamstring injury is unrelated to previous issues. "It's unfortunate that it happened at the very beginning of his career, but hopefully this is the one and only injury that he has," Loomis said. "We're really encouraged by what we saw in training camp when he was practicing before he got injured, and we're looking forward to having him back." The Saints are working out in Versailles, France, ahead of Sunday's international game against the Pittsburgh Steelers. Saints head coach Kellen Moore stirred excitement for Tyson's return when he confirmed the rookie would travel to Paris. Tyson, 22, was placed on injured reserve, which by rule comes with a requirement to miss four games. In 33 games in college, Tyson caught 158 passes for 2,282 yards with 22 touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: EEUU pretende prestar hasta un tercio de reservas de diésel de calefacción para controlar precios
item.description: El Gobierno de Donald Trump se ha ofrecido a prestar hasta casi un tercio de la reserva de emergencia de diésel para calefacción de Estados Unidos, que asciende a un millón de barriles, informó el miércoles el Departamento de Energía, en un intento por frenar la subida de los precios.
item.dc:creator: Timothy Gardner
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Donald Trump se ha ofrecido a prestar hasta casi un tercio de la reserva de emergencia de diésel para calefacción de Estados Unidos, que asciende a un millón de barriles, informó el miércoles el Departamento de Energía, en un intento por frenar la subida de los precios. La medida, de la que informó en primicia Reuters, se anuncia después de que senadores de ambos partidos políticos instaron a la Administración a liberar gasóleo de calefacción de la reserva. El diésel de calefacción tiene una composición similar a la del de motor, cuyo precio ha alcanzado máximos históricos sobre los 6,50 dólares por galón tras las perturbaciones en Oriente Medio provocadas por la guerra con Irán. El Gobierno Trump también achaca los altos precios a los ataques ucranianos contra refinerías en Rusia. La Administración evaluará si es necesario realizar más liberaciones de la reserva, dijo una fuente del departamento. Estados Unidos solo ha recurrido a la Reserva de Gasóleo de Calefacción del Noreste una vez desde que el huracán Sandy azotó la región en 2012. Las reservas de emergencia se encuentran en instalaciones de Nueva Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts y Maine. El aumento vertiginoso de los precios del diésel de calefacción se ha convertido en un asunto crucial antes de las elecciones legislativas del 3 de noviembre, en las que los compañeros republicanos de Trump intentan mantener el control de las dos cámaras del Congreso. El secretario de Energía de Estados Unidos, Chris Wright, dijo que la Administración estaba "comprometida a hacer todo lo que esté en nuestra mano para reducir los costos energéticos". El departamento indicó que se llevaría a cabo un proceso de licitación competitiva para los préstamos, tanto para los minoristas de combustible como para los propietarios de terminales, con el fin de permitir que el combustible llegue a las zonas que sufren escasez.

item.title: UK regulator ends Home REIT investigation
item.description: Britain's financial regulator has closed its two-year investigation into London-listed Home REIT , a British social housing company, although the watchdog said on Wednesday that it supported an ongoing criminal investigation.
item.dc:creator: Kirstin Ridley
item.content:encoded: Britain's financial regulator has closed its two-year investigation into London-listed Home REIT (HOMEH.L) , a British social housing company, although the watchdog said on Wednesday that it supported an ongoing criminal investigation. The Financial Conduct Authority ended the probe without taking any action, helping send the company's beleaguered shares 3.7% higher at the market close, their biggest daily percentage gain since June. "We have carefully considered the case and believe the best way forward is to support the Serious Fraud Office's ongoing investigation," an FCA spokesperson said. The watchdog is reserving its rights to review its decision if new information comes to light. Home REIT's Chair Michael O'Donnell said the FCA investigation was closed following the company's "extensive cooperation". The UK Serious Fraud Office, however, [USN:L8N3YF1AO TEXT:"arrested"] six people in January in an estimated £300 million ($401 million) bribery and fraud investigation. Seven sites were searched, including a home in the Italian city of Venice. Home REIT, which listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2020, bought properties across Britain, raising more than £850 million in its first three years of trading. The company told investors their funds would help to buy and restore properties that would be block-let to publicly funded charities and community interest companies to house rough sleepers, veterans and people struggling with addiction. Rent payments would generate returns for investors. But a report by short-seller Viceroy Research in November 2022 raised concerns that included the valuation of the properties and the ability of the tenants to pay rent. The company [USN:L4N32Q1IW TEXT:"rejected"] the allegations, but its shares were temporarily suspended from trading in January 2023. More than 800 investors are [USN:L8N45N122 TEXT:"suing"] Home REIT, alleging they were misled about the security of the company's rental income, its financial strength and its stated social impact. ($1 = 0.7474 pounds)

item.title: Covivio-Hausse de 2,7% des revenus sur les neufs premiers mois
item.description: Covivio a fait état mercredi d'une croissance de 2,7% de ses revenus à périmètre constant sur les neufs premiers mois de son exercice, soutenus entre autres par les hausses de loyers et les gains de taux d'occupation ainsi que les revenus variables des hôtels.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Covivio (CVO.PA) a fait état mercredi d'une croissance de 2,7% de ses revenus à périmètre constant sur les neufs premiers mois de son exercice, soutenus entre autres par les hausses de loyers et les gains de taux d'occupation ainsi que les revenus variables des hôtels. L'entreprise française de gestion foncière affiche des revenus en part du groupe de 531 millions d'euros, et un taux d'occupation à 96,4%. Dans le segment des bureaux, les loyers ont augmenté de +2,5% à périmètre constant, tandis qu'ils progressent de +5,3% à périmètre courant dans l’hôtellerie. L'entreprise française a confirmé ses objectifs 2026, dont une hausse de 4% de son résultat net récurrent par action.

item.title: FDJ United abaisse ses objectifs de CA et de produit brut des jeux
item.description: FDJ United a annoncé mercredi un abaissement de ses objectifs annuels, tablant désormais sur une baisse comprise entre 1% et 3% ("low-single digit") du produit brut des jeux (PBJ) et sur un déclin d'environ 5% ("mid-single digit") de son chiffre d'affaires pour l'exercice 2026.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: FDJ United (FDJU.PA) a annoncé mercredi un abaissement de ses objectifs annuels, tablant désormais sur une baisse comprise entre 1% et 3% ("low-single digit") du produit brut des jeux (PBJ) et sur un déclin d'environ 5% ("mid-single digit") de son chiffre d'affaires pour l'exercice 2026. Le groupe avait dit [USN:FWN43V1IY TEXT:"en juillet"] tabler sur un PBJ stable et une baisse comprise entre 1% et 3% de son chiffre d'affaires. "L’activité de FDJ United à fin septembre reflète à nouveau des aléas propres au secteur des jeux, une baisse de la fréquentation des points de vente dans un contexte économique défavorable, ainsi que l'augmentation attendue de la fiscalité", a déclaré la présidente-directrice générale Stéphane Pallez dans un communiqué. Les hausses de la fiscalités s'élèvent à 62 millions d'euros pour le groupe précise le communiqué. Sur les neuf premiers mois de 2026, FDJ United a enregistré un PBJ de 6,264 milliards d'euros, soit une baisse de 2,8% par rapport à la même période l'an passé, et un chiffre d’affaires de 2,576 milliards, un repli de 5,6 % par rapport à la même période l'an passé.

item.title: eBay despedirá a unos 1.000 empleados en su segunda ronda de recortes de 2026
item.description: Los recortes afectarán a cerca del 9% de la plantilla de la compañía, según una fuente familiarizada con el asunto. En febrero, eBay anunció la eliminación de unos 800 puestos de trabajo.
item.dc:creator: Spencer Soper
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Según una persona familiarizada con el asunto, eBay Inc. ( EBAY ) eliminará el 9% de su plantilla, lo que supone la segunda ronda de recortes de empleo de la compañía este año. Según la fuente, que pidió permanecer en el anonimato porque los detalles no son públicos, los recortes afectarán a unos 1.000 empleados. Reuters informó previamente sobre los despidos, citando un memorando interno del director ejecutivo de la empresa. Ver más: eBay rechaza la oferta de GameStop por no ser “ni creíble ni atractiva” “Mientras trabajamos para aprovechar la importante oportunidad que tenemos por delante, tomamos esta medida para garantizar que sigamos operando desde una posición de fortaleza, alineando nuestros equipos y recursos con nuestras principales prioridades estratégicas”, dijo un portavoz de eBay en un comunicado enviado por correo electrónico. Las acciones de la compañía subieron aproximadamente un 1,2% a las 11:05 de la mañana en Nueva York. En mayo, eBay rechazó una oferta de adquisición de US$56.000 millones del CEO de Gamestop Corp., Ryan Cohen, calificando la oferta de “ni creíble ni atractiva”. Al presentar la oferta, Cohen se comprometió a encontrar ahorros de costes por valor de US$2.000 millones en los 12 meses posteriores al cierre del acuerdo y sugirió que el gasto en marketing del CEO e eBay, Jamie Iannone, había sido un despilfarro. Ver más: eBay sube 5% tras oferta de GameStop, pero dudas de Wall Street afectan opción de inversión Iannone, que asumió el cargo de director ejecutivo en 2020, se ha centrado en impulsar las ventas en categorías selectas, como artículos de lujo, productos reacondicionados y objetos de colección. Estas últimas reducciones se suman a una ronda de recortes de personal en febrero, cuando eBay anunció la eliminación de unos 800 puestos de trabajo, lo que representaba el 6% de su plantilla en aquel momento. La compañía también redujo su personal a principios de 2023 y principios de 2024. Ver más: La jugada del CEO de GameStop: qué busca con su oferta de US$56.000 millones por eBay A principios de este año, eBay adquirió Depop, una plataforma de venta de moda de segunda mano, una operación que se espera ayude a eBay a competir con la emergente empresa lituana Vinted, que se está expandiendo en Estados Unidos. En agosto, eBay anunció que la adquisición de Depop ascendía a US$200 millones más de lo anunciado inicialmente, lo que podría afectar a sus ganancias en el tercer trimestre. La empresa tiene previsto presentar sus resultados financieros el 28 de octubre. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: As Russia penalises European firms over Ukraine, US rivals largely spared
item.description: Russia has deepened a crackdown on European companies in response to Europe's support for Ukraine, while largely sparing US firms as Moscow courts business ties with Washington, Russian officials and US business people said.
item.dc:creator: Gleb Bryanski
item.content:encoded: Russia has deepened a crackdown on European companies in response to Europe's support for Ukraine, while largely sparing US firms as Moscow courts business ties with Washington, Russian officials and US business people said. Of 20 foreign-owned firms that Russian President Vladimir Putin has placed under temporary administration since Donald Trump's inauguration as US president in January 2025, only three were linked to the US, with the remainder controlled by European companies, a Reuters analysis of official data shows. A person close to Russian financial regulators said that while business negotiations were underway with Washington, it was not in Moscow's interest to take as tough a line on US firms as the Kremlin was adopting towards those from Europe. US special envoy Steve Witkoff met Putin in St Petersburg on Wednesday for [USN:L6N4670LA TEXT:"talks"] aimed at resolving the war in Ukraine. Russian news agencies reported Putin told Witkoff he was interested in restoring economic ties with the United States. Ukraine and its allies have voiced concerns that the US is backing away from Kyiv, and Trump has criticized Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil refineries even as European leaders have lined up behind Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy. Russia, citing Europe's wartime support for Ukraine and involvement in "direct battlefield hostilities", has since last month taken control of local units of Swiss food group Nestle (NESN.S) and retailers Auchan and Metro (B4B0n.H) . Last week it [USN:L1N46208D TEXT:"seized control"] of the local assets of four smaller companies from France, Germany, Sweden and Belgium. "Their country of origin was one of the factors taken into account in making the decision," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said, adding that these countries were involved in "illegal expropriations of Russian property". Nestle, which said in [USN:L8N45A06P TEXT:"September"] it would take steps to protect its rights in Russia, declined to comment further. The other companies did not respond to requests for comment. A spokesperson for Switzerland's State Secretariat for Economic Affairs said that the available information supported the perception that more European than US firms were being hit. The Kremlin declined to comment on how it was treating US and European companies in Russia, while the White House did not respond to a request for comment. 'WE HAVE TRUMP' Russia's relations with the Trump administration, meanwhile, have warmed. The US announced a deal this month to buy Russian diesel and other deals, including on gas, have been discussed at meetings in recent months. Trump signed an executive order on [USN:L1N463009 TEXT:"Saturday"] waiving key sanctions and tariffs on Russian goods. Russian negotiator Kirill Dmitriev, a US-educated investment banker who heads the Russian Direct Investment Fund (RDIF) and has pushed in talks for the return and expansion of US firms, hailed the move as a "historic moment". Trump's envoys Witkoff and Jared Kushner have used the prospect of multibillion-dollar deals with Russia as an incentive to push Putin toward a peaceful settlement since the start of talks in the Saudi capital, Riyadh, in February 2025. Dmitriev said last week Russia and the US would soon announce new joint initiatives that could move ahead before the war ends. The US has previously signalled that deals are unlikely while the conflict continues. One person familiar with the situation said that some Russian officials who do not support peace efforts could yet push for the Kremlin's actions to include more US companies. The RDIF's only current partnership with a US company is a joint investment with New York-listed Titan International in a tyre factory in Volgograd. Another person familiar with the situation said Dmitriev has in private highlighted this as an example of a thriving US business in Russia. Titan did not respond to a request for comment. Trump's commitment to economic cooperation with Russia and ongoing talks have helped to protect the interests of US companies, two US business people in Moscow said. American Chamber of Commerce Russia President Robert Agee said in December last year that European firms in Russia were less optimistic than American ones, citing European policy. The chamber estimates there are some 300 US firms left in Russia. "We have Trump and they don't, and our hopes are linked to him," Agee told Russian media last year. Agee and the chamber declined to comment further for this story. Russia did target some mid-sized US firms during its property redistribution drive after the start of the war. [USN:L8N3T606G TEXT:"One report estimated"] Moscow seized more than $50 billion worth of private property from both Russian and foreign owners. The European Commission in Brussels declined to comment on the number of EU firms being targeted relative to US ones, but said the recent asset seizures were without due process and amounted to "forced expropriation in all but name". "This follows a clear pattern of economic retaliation," a Commission spokesperson told Reuters, adding that the moves showed that "Russia is not a safe environment for business". "The EU has measures in place to respond. We can sanction those profiting from forced expropriations," they added.

item.title: Two uncapped players named in Ireland squad for Nations Championship
item.description: Ireland named the uncapped Ulster pair of Jamie Benson and James McNabney in a 36-man squad for next month's Nations Championship games, but are also missing injured personnel, including skipper Caelan Doris.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ireland named the uncapped Ulster pair of Jamie Benson and James McNabney in a 36-man squad for next month's Nations Championship games, but are also missing injured personnel, including skipper Caelan Doris. Dan Sheehan will again captain the team in the absence of Doris, who has been joined on the sidelines by Jack Conan, who injured his shoulder in Leinster's 48-23 win away to Clermont Auvergne in the European Champions Cup last weekend. Also out through injury are Harry Byrne, Jack Crowley, Iain Henderson, Paddy McCarthy, Calvin Nash and Bryn Ward. Ryan Baird, Mack Hansen, Tommy O'Brien and Andrew Porter return after missing out on the away fixtures in the Nations Championship against Australia, Japan and New Zealand in July. Former England junior international Benson, who can play several roles in the backline, is included after only four games for Ulster after moving from English club Harlequins. McNabney returns after sitting out last season with a serious knee injury. Ireland host Argentina, Fiji and South Africa in Dublin on the first three weekends of November before heading to Twickenham for the final weekend. Squad Backs: Bundee Aki (Connacht), Rob Baloucoune, Jamie Benson (both Ulster), Craig Casey (Munster), Nathan Doak (Ulster), Ciarán Frawley (Connacht), Jamison Gibson-Park (Leinster), Mack Hansen (Connacht), Robbie Henshaw, Hugo Keenan (both Leinster), Stuart McCloskey (Ulster), Jimmy O’Brien, Tommy O’Brien, Jamie Osborne, Sam Prendergast, Garry Ringrose (all Leinster), Jacob Stockdale (Ulster). Forwards: Ryan Baird (Leinster), Tadhg Beirne (Munster), Billy Bohan (Connacht), Thomas Clarkson, Tadhg Furlong (both Leinster), Sam Illo, Sean Jansen (both Connacht), Ronan Kelleher, Joe McCarthy (both Leinster), James McNabney (Ulster), Darragh Murray (Connacht), Tom O'Toole (Ulster), Andrew Porter (Leinster), Cian Prendergast (Connacht), James Ryan, Dan Sheehan (both Leinster), Tom Stewart, Nick Timoney (both Ulster), Josh van der Flier (Leinster).

item.title: World Aquatics names 2027 Swimming World Cup hosts
item.description: World Aquatics on Wednesday named Berlin, Paris and London as the host cities for the 2027 Swimming World Cup, with the three-stop series also offering direct qualification opportunities for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World Aquatics on Wednesday named Berlin, Paris and London as the host cities for the 2027 Swimming World Cup, with the three-stop series also offering direct qualification opportunities for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. Berlin will host the opening leg from October 15-17, followed by Paris from October 22-24 and London from October 29-31. Athletes will be able to secure direct Olympic qualification in the newly introduced 50 metres butterfly, backstroke and breaststroke events across the series. The men's 50m backstroke and women's 50m butterfly qualifiers will be decided in Berlin, while Paris will determine the men's 50m butterfly and women's 50m breaststroke qualifiers. The final qualification places will be awarded in London's Aquatics Centre, where the men's 50m breaststroke and women's 50m backstroke events will serve as Olympic qualifiers. "Each city has an outstanding sporting pedigree and Olympic heritage and therefore offers a fitting stage to determine the qualifiers for 50m events newly-introduced onto the Olympic programme for LA28," said World Aquatics President Husain Al Musallam.

item.title: La Russie a accepté la réunion trilatérale avec l'Ukraine proposée par les USA-représentant US
item.description: La Russie a accepté la proposition des Etats-Unis d'organiser une réunion trilatérale avec l'Ukraine, a déclaré mercredi un représentant américain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Russie a accepté la proposition des Etats-Unis d'organiser une réunion trilatérale avec l'Ukraine, a déclaré mercredi un représentant américain. Un peu plus tôt, le Kremlin a fait savoir que le président russe Vladimir Poutine avait accepté de reprendre les efforts de paix chapeautés par Washington pour mettre fin à la guerre, entrée en février dernier dans sa cinquième année. Cette annonce survient alors que Steve Witkoff, l'émissaire spécial du président américain Donald Trump, s'est rendu dans la journée à Saint-Pétersbourg pour une rencontre avec Vladimir Poutine, lors de laquelle a été convenue la libération du ressortissant américain [USN:L6N4670TT TEXT:"Stephen Hubbard"], emprisonné en Russie depuis 2022. En parallèle, le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a répété être [USN:L6N4670YO TEXT:"disposé à des pourparlers"] avec les Etats-Unis et la Russie, au lendemain de discussions en Norvège avec Steve Witkoff et des dirigeants européens.

item.title: Serbia arrests six people suspected of plotting election-day violence
item.description: Serbian police arrested six people on Wednesday on suspicion of preparing violence against police and political opponents in a parliamentary election on Sunday, prosecutors said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Serbian police arrested six people on Wednesday on suspicion of preparing violence against police and political opponents in a parliamentary election on Sunday, prosecutors said. The Higher Public Prosecutor's Office said in a statement that five of the suspects had been arrested in the northern city of Novi Sad on suspicion of having "incited and encouraged the overthrow of the highest state authorities by force." They had recruited people whom they intended to bring to Belgrade on election day to attack political opponents and police, it said. The sixth person, who was arrested in Belgrade, was suspected of being in charge of training so-called mobile teams for physical confrontations and violence as if "preparing for war," the statement said. Former President [USN:L6N45J062 TEXT:"Aleksandar Vucic"], who resigned as head of state last month, called an early election last month after 18 months of anti-government protests led by students, and wants to extend his 12-year hold on power by becoming prime minister. The election is expected to be a [USN:L8N4650K6 TEXT:"close race"] between a list of candidates backed by Vucic and a student-backed list of candidates pledging to fight graft and ensure the rule of law.

item.title: What is PHP and why did it take government websites offline?
item.description: Government websites across Europe went dark on Wednesday as operators raced to patch two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, one of the most widely used programming languages on the web.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: Government websites across Europe went dark on Wednesday as operators raced to patch two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, one of the most widely used programming languages on the web. The developers of PHP said on Wednesday they would release patches for two critical vulnerabilities, and EU cybersecurity officials warned organisations unable to apply the fixes to take affected websites offline. Here is what you need to know: WHAT IS PHP? PHP is a programming language that runs websites. It works behind the scenes. When a user loads a page, the server running PHP assembles the content and sends the finished page to the browser. It is free, open source and maintained by volunteers. Site owners rarely interact with it directly. PHP runs nearly 70% of all websites whose programming language can be identified, according to web technology tracker W3Techs. It is the engine behind WordPress, the software that powers about 40% of all websites such as blogs, small business pages, government portals, online shops and news sites. WHAT ARE THE RISKS OF THE FLAWS? The two vulnerabilities are rated 9.2 out of 10 on the CVSS v4.0 severity scale, a standard industry scoring system. CERT-EU, the European Union's cybersecurity response team, said that rating signals unauthenticated remote code execution, meaning an attacker can run commands on a vulnerable server, over the internet, with no password or account. A single flaw in PHP opens the same door on millions of servers at once. Whoever exploits the flaw controls the website. GoDaddy (GDDY.N) , a web hosting provider, said that could mean stolen data, defaced pages or full-system compromise. Cloudflare's (NET.N) chief technology officer said early attacks were emerging. Most small websites are typically run by owners with no security staff, often on shared hosting where they do not manage the server and may not know who updates PHP. Wordfence, a security plugin for WordPress sites, warned that the usual automatic updates will not apply this fix. CERT-EU's guidance is to take affected sites offline rather than leave them exposed. HOW WAS IT FOUND? Researchers at security firm Calif, working with OpenAI, reported the first flaw to PHP on August 11 after finding it with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model, the company said. Wiz, a security firm owned by Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google, found the flaws independently and reported a second one on August 24, also using AI models. Wiz said the findings "rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history." The underlying flaws had been present for decades, the firm said, but proving they were exploitable required a chain of steps "at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve." US President Donald Trump's administration said it was "tracking and coordinating with federal agencies and leading SI labs to expedite the release of the fix," referring to Trump's preferred name for artificial intelligence. It framed the discovery as evidence that American "Super Intelligence" strengthens national security.

item.title: Oklahoma sticking with QB John Mateer despite turnovers
item.description: Oklahoma still sees John Mateer as its best option at quarterback.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Oklahoma still sees John Mateer as its best option at quarterback. The Sooners are not making a change at the position despite last week's costly three-interception performance. Oklahoma (3-3, 1-2) has only one win in SEC play, a 27-24 upset against then-No. 1 Texas on Oct. 10. Offensive coordinator Ben Arbuckle, who also coached Mateer at Washington State, said the coaching staff will do more to keep the ball out of harm's way starting on Saturday at Mississippi State (4-2, 2-2). "Everything that he's done, the player that he is, the preparation that he has, we believe that John Mateer gives us the best chance to win," Arbuckle said. The Sooners are coming off a 21-13 home loss last Saturday to then-No. 15 Kentucky in a game in which Mateer threw his fifth, sixth and seventh interceptions of the season. Oklahoma is minus-8 in turnover margin, tied for 134th among 138 FBS programs. "We have to eliminate backbreaking errors, catastrophic errors," Arbuckle said. "For all the good that he (Mateer) does, we have to eliminate those. He's not alone in that. I take full responsibility for those plays, whenever they happen." --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump vai destacar repressão a golpes envolvendo criptomoedas no exterior
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, destacará nesta quarta-feira os esforços de seu governo para reprimir redes estrangeiras que atraem norte-americanos para investimentos fraudulentos em criptomoedas, informou uma autoridade da Casa Branca à Reuters, como parte de um evento mais amplo sobre a prevenção ao crime digital.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, destacará nesta quarta-feira os esforços de seu governo para reprimir redes estrangeiras que atraem norte-americanos para investimentos fraudulentos em criptomoedas, informou uma autoridade da Casa Branca à Reuters, como parte de um evento mais amplo sobre a prevenção ao crime digital. Em discurso durante um evento na Casa Branca, Trump e membros de seu gabinete devem destacar a apreensão pelo governo norte-americano de sites fraudulentos de investimento em criptomoedas e os esforços para coibir golpes de falsificação de identidade online, disse a autoridade. O secretário de Segurança Interna, Markwayne Mullin, o diretor do FBI, Kash Patel, o secretário de Defesa, Pete Hegseth, e o procurador-geral, Todd Blanche, devem comparecer, acrescentou o funcionário. A chefe de gabinete da Casa Branca, Susie Wiles, o vice-chefe de gabinete, Stephen Miller, e o diretor nacional de segurança eletrônica, Sean Cairncross, também devem estar presentes, segundo um funcionário do governo. Os norte-americanos registraram mais de um milhão de denúncias junto ao FBI sobre golpes na internet no ano passado, um aumento de 17% em relação a 2024, de acordo com um relatório da agência, que também observou que os norte-americanos que registraram denúncias relataram as maiores perdas. A família de Trump está fortemente envolvida na captação de investimentos em criptomoedas. Uma investigação da Reuters revelou que o presidente republicano e seus filhos aumentaram a fortuna da família em pelo menos US$2,3 bilhões por meio de seus principais empreendimentos no setor de criptomoedas, enquanto os investidores que eles atraíram sofreram perdas de US$2,3 bilhões. A porta-voz da Casa Branca, Anna Kelly, em comunicado à Reuters sobre a investigação, afirmou: “Todas as ações do presidente Trump e de seu governo são tomadas no melhor interesse do povo norte-americano.” Em outubro de 2025, Trump perdoou Changpeng Zhao, o fundador condenado da corretora de criptomoedas Binance. Zhao deixou o cargo depois que a empresa se declarou culpada por não manter um programa eficaz de combate à lavagem de dinheiro. Em um decreto de março, Trump instruiu o Departamento de Justiça a priorizar a identificação e o julgamento de golpistas que cometem crimes online. Posteriormente, Trump instruiu o Departamento de Segurança Interna a trabalhar com empresas privadas para monitorar grupos criminosos estrangeiros de hackers.

item.title: Retornos bonos Tesoro EEUU caen ante preocupación por riesgos de la IA; aguardan subasta a 20 años
item.description: Los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos caían el miércoles, mientras los inversores evaluaban el impacto de la subida de las tasas de interés en las acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial, que han contribuido a impulsar el crecimiento económico, a la espera de una subasta de deuda a 20 años prevista para más tarde ese mismo día.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: Los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos caían el miércoles, mientras los inversores evaluaban el impacto de la subida de las tasas de interés en las acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial, que han contribuido a impulsar el crecimiento económico, a la espera de una subasta de deuda a 20 años prevista para más tarde ese mismo día. * Los rendimientos se han mostrado sensibles a los movimientos de los mercados bursátiles en los últimos días, ya que las preocupaciones sobre el impacto del aumento de los costos de financiación en las acciones de infraestructuras de IA, como CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , han lastrado en ocasiones a las acciones y han aumentado el atractivo de los bonos del Tesoro como valor refugio, provocando un descenso en los retornos. * Las acciones estadounidenses subían levemente el miércoles, impulsadas en parte por el repunte de los papeles de SpaceX (SPCX.O) después de que sus resultados trimestrales disiparan en parte las preocupaciones sobre el sector de la IA, aunque los títulos de CoreWeave cedían. * "Se ha producido una compensación muy clara en los mercados de capitales, en lo que casi podría denominarse una rotación entre el apetito por el riesgo y la aversión al riesgo, en la que las acciones se deprecian y se observan flujos de entrada y salida del mercado de bonos del Tesoro", afirmó Bill Northey, director sénior de inversiones de U.S. Bank Wealth Management, en Billings, Montana. * El rendimiento a 10 años bajaba 1,5 puntos básicos, al 5,102%, rumbo hacia su segunda caída diaria seguida. La rentabilidad a 30 años descendía 1,2 puntos básicos, al 5,413%. * Esta semana llegará más oferta al mercado cuando el Tesoro subaste 13.000 millones de dólares en deuda a 20 años más tarde el miércoles y 26.000 millones de dólares en títulos protegidos contra la inflación (TIPS) a 5 años el jueves. * Un indicador muy seguido de la curva que mide la diferencia entre las tasas de los bonos del Tesoro a dos y 10 años , que se considera un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situaba en 32,2 puntos básicos. * El rendimiento a dos años , que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Fed, perdía 0,9 puntos básicos al 4,778%.

item.title: Italie Les commerçants préviennent de pénuries alimentaires dues au mouvement des routiers
item.description: Des pénuries alimentaires pourraient voir le jour en Italie en raison du mouvement de protestation des routiers italiens contre les prix du carburant et le coût de la vie, les livraisons étant perturbées, ont dit mercredi les commerçants du pays.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des pénuries alimentaires pourraient voir le jour en Italie en raison du mouvement de protestation des routiers italiens contre les prix du carburant et le coût de la vie, les livraisons étant perturbées, ont dit mercredi les commerçants du pays. Ces manifestations, qui ont débuté la semaine dernière dans le sud de l'Italie, désorganisent également l'activité de deux aéroports régionaux en Calabre, dans le sud de l'Italie, privés d'approvisionnement en kérosène. Avec une circulation paralysée dans diverses régions du pays, de longues files d’attente se sont formées sur l’autoroute A1 près de la ville de Naples, dans le sud, après que les routiers en ont restreint l’accès. Des camions et des tracteurs ont également envahi la place centrale de la ville de Ravenne, dans le nord-est du pays, signe que le mouvement s'étend géographiquement et à d'autres corps de métier comme les agriculteurs. Le vice-président du Conseil des ministres Matteo Salvini a déclaré que le gouvernement était prêt à envisager un plafonnement des prix du diesel afin d'aider à alléger la pression sur les transporteurs. L'Italie a débloqué environ un milliard d'euros cette année pour aider les chauffeurs routiers à faire face à la flambée des coûts du carburant et à remplacer leurs anciens véhicules par des modèles moins polluants. Ces manifestations interviennent à un moment où le gouvernement fait face à des troubles survenus le week-end dernier dans des villes du nord, notamment à Milan, où des actes de vandalisme ont été observés. Le groupe ANCD-Conad, qui représente les détaillants opérant sous l'enseigne de supermarchés Conad, a déclaré que de grandes quantités de produits périssables, notamment des fruits et légumes, ainsi que du lait et de la viande, étaient bloquées dans des camions et des entrepôts en raison du mouvement des routiers. "La liberté de manifester ne peut se traduire par une atteinte au droit des citoyens à recevoir des denrées alimentaires fraîches ni par la destruction de la valeur créée par les filières agroalimentaires italiennes", a déclaré le président du groupe, Maurizio Pelliconi. Des producteurs de pâtes et acteurs de l'industrie meunière ont [USN:L6N4660WB TEXT:"précédemment averti"] que la production italienne de pâtes était menacée par les manifestations des chauffeurs routiers.

LONDON/PARIS, Oct 21 : Financial regulators in Europe are questioning Google after a cloud computing outage on Tuesday left millions of bank customers without access to key financial services for hours. The European Banking Authority said that it has been in contact with Google Cloud to obtain further information on the incident, understand its implications and assess its potential impact on financial entities in the EU, a spokesperson for the watchdog told Reuters. Alphabet's Google said the disruption, which lasted several hours, was caused by a "power event" in a London-based network that serves customers across Europe. Revolut, Lloyds and HSBC were among the banks affected. Lloyds and HSBC did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

A Google spokesperson said: "We have resolved a disruption to Google Cloud services at a third-party facility in our europe-west2 cloud region due to a power event. Services have been restored. We will update our public status dashboard with an analysis." At Revolut, which has around 13 million UK customers, a wide range of services including logging in, card payments and cash withdrawals were affected on Tuesday, according to the bank's website. Revolut said in a statement that it was reviewing the incident to reduce the impact of any future third-party disruptions, and that customer funds and data had remained safe throughout. The outage is the first major test of new rules across Europe designed to strengthen the resilience of technology providers, including cloud firms, on which the financial sector depends. The European Union last year designated 19 technology firms as critical third-party providers to the financial sector, bringing them under joint direct oversight of three financial regulators — including the EBA — for the first time. Britain took similar steps for four cloud providers, citing the risk that an outage at a major supplier could affect multiple financial firms at the same time. Google Cloud falls under both regulatory frameworks. In Britain, parliament's Treasury Committee has written to the Bank of England and the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), seeking details of the regulators' response to the outage on Tuesday, the scale of the disruption and any financial harm caused. The FCA said it was engaging with Google over the incident. Under Britain's critical third party regime, designated providers like Google Cloud must report serious outages to the FCA and the BoE. A spokesperson for the Bank of England declined to comment. Under UK rules, banks ultimately are responsible for the services they provide to customers, including when they rely on third-party providers.

Source: Reuters

item.description: British recruiter SThree said on Wednesday that the UK takeover panel has granted US-based staffing firm Circle8 an extra 28 days, until November 18, to decide whether to make an offer for the company.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British recruiter SThree (STEMS.L) said on Wednesday that the UK takeover panel has granted US-based staffing firm Circle8 (CIRC.O) an extra 28 days, until November 18, to decide whether to make an offer for the company. Here are more details: SThree's London-listed shares were up 4.36% at 311 pence in afternoon trade The British recruiter, which has a market value of £358 million ($479.22 million) confirmed that discussions between the company and Circle8 are ongoing The takeover panel had first [USN:L6N45T0YF TEXT:"extended the deadline"] for Circle8 to make an offer for SThree to October 21 In September, SThree [USN:L6N4530Q7 TEXT:"rejected"] an unsolicited approach from Circle8, saying the proposal significantly undervalued the recruiter and its long-term prospects In October, Circle8 had [USN:L6N45T0YF TEXT:"made a revised proposal"] featuring an improved cash offer and asked for more time to announce a firm intention to bid Circle8 had not disclosed the financial terms for the possible cash offer for SThree ($1 = 0.7470 pounds)

item.content:encoded:
アップルの折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ「デュオ」、23日発売　店頭は数量限定 0:39 配信

米アップルの折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ「Ｄｕｏ（デュオ）」。カリフォルニア州のスティーブ・ジョブズ・シアターで開催された同社イベントで９月撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Stephen Nellis

[サンフランシスコ　２１日　ロイター] - 米アップルは２１日、２３日に発売される同社初の折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ「Ｄｕｏ（デュオ）」 について、店頭に来店した顧客向けに「数量限定」で提供すると発表した。オンラインでの先行予約が数分で完売し、一部顧客への配送時期が来年１月にずれ込んでいることを受けた措置となる。

アップルは声明で「２３日の朝、アップルストアで『iPhone Duo』や素晴らしいiPhoneのラインアップを体験してもらえることを楽しみにしている」と表明。「アップルストアでは『iPhone Duo』を来店客向けに数量限定で用意しており、この革新的な新製品をできるだけ早く届けられるよう尽力している」と述べた。

アップルは、当日店頭で購入できる台数は国・地域によって異なるとしている。オンライン予約の店頭受け取りおよび数量限定の店頭販売は、米国、オーストラリア、カナダ、メキシコ、英国と欧州の大部分で利用可能となる。

一方、オンラインで事前購入した顧客のみに提供される地域もあり、中国本土、フランス、香港、インド、日本、マレーシア、韓国、台湾、タイ、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）が含まれるとした。

item.title: Sisi says Egypt would defend Saudi territory but rules out attack on Yemen
item.description: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said Egypt's military support for Saudi Arabia would be limited to defending the kingdom's territory and borders and would not include an attack on Yemen, the presidency said on Wednesday, as the Iran-allied Houthis intensify attacks on the kingdom.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said Egypt's military support for Saudi Arabia would be limited to defending the kingdom's territory and borders and would not include an attack on Yemen, the presidency said on Wednesday, as the Iran-allied Houthis intensify attacks on the kingdom. Sisi's comments came as Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and intelligence chief Hassan Rashad met Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in Riyadh, Saudi state news agency SPA said. Abdelatty delivered a written message from Sisi to King Salman, and the two sides discussed bilateral ties and regional developments, SPA said. Any Egyptian military backing for Saudi Arabia could mark a significant escalation in the broader Middle East conflict, which has threatened global energy supplies and pushed oil prices higher since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February. Egypt would also defend the territory of any other Arab country if asked, Sisi said, but its military effort would not extend beyond Egyptian territory or that of an Arab state whose security and stability Cairo was seeking to protect. On Monday, Egypt's parliament [USN:L6N4650W2 TEXT:"delayed"] until October 26 a vote on authorizing the armed forces to support Saudi Arabia if requested, lawmakers said. Fighting between the Saudi-led coalition backing Yemen's internationally recognised government and the Houthis, who control the capital Sanaa and much of the north, has escalated in recent weeks, opening another front in the US-Israeli war on Iran . Egypt and Saudi Arabia are close strategic and economic partners. Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states, including the United Arab Emirates, provided Egypt with billions of dollars in aid, central bank deposits and investments after the 2013 military overthrow of Islamist President Mohamed Mursi. Sisi became president a year later. Egypt, a regional military power, previously joined the Saudi-led coalition that intervened in Yemen in 2015 in support of the government against the Houthis, though it played a limited combat role in the civil war.

item.title: Supreme Court won't allow Trump administration restrictions on transgender inmates
item.description: The US Supreme Court rejected on Wednesday a bid by President Donald Trump's administration to immediately enforce a policy restricting gender-affirming care for transgender inmates in federal prisons in a rare win for transgender rights at the nation's top judicial body.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chung
item.content:encoded: The US Supreme Court rejected on Wednesday a bid by President Donald Trump 's administration to immediately enforce a policy restricting gender-affirming care for transgender inmates in federal prisons in a rare win for transgender rights at the nation's top judicial body. The court denied the Justice Department's emergency request to lift a federal judge's order blocking the Federal Bureau of Prisons from implementing the policy, while a legal challenge to the measure plays out. The policy, issued in February, prohibits medical and surgical treatments as well as any "social accommodations" such as clothing and hair-removal devices that could be used to alter a person's appearance to align with their gender identity. The policy would still allow for psychiatric services to be provided. Three transgender inmates incarcerated at federal correctional institutions in New Jersey, Florida and Minnesota filed a class action lawsuit challenging the policy. The Supreme Court's brief order gave no explanation for its action, as is common when the justices handle emergency requests. Conservative Justices Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito publicly dissented from the decision. "This ruling will prevent serious and irreparable harm to plaintiffs and the class while we continue to challenge the government's unlawful efforts to deny medically necessary healthcare for political reasons," said Aditi Shah, an attorney at the American Civil Liberties Union, which helps represent the inmates challenging the policy. The Bureau of Prisons declined to comment on the decision. There are more than 2,000 transgender inmates in federal facilities and halfway houses, according to a government figure from 2025. The new restrictions would reverse the government's prior procedures. The federal prison system has treated people with gender dysphoria with hormones since at least 1992, according to the plaintiffs. Gender dysphoria is a term for the clinical diagnosis of significant distress that can result from an incongruence between a person's gender identity and sex at birth. TRUMP EXECUTIVE ORDER Trump has taken a hard line on transgender rights since returning to office in January 2025. The president issued an executive order on his first day back in office recognizing only two genders — male and female — and casting transgender identity as a lie. The directive ordered changes across numerous federal agencies, including that "males are not detained in women's prisons" and halting funding for treatments "for the purpose of conforming an inmate's appearance to that of the opposite sex." In the litigation, the administration has called medical care provided for gender transition "unproven sex-rejecting interventions." Siding with the administration would cause "immediate and catastrophic" harm, the plaintiffs said in a court filing, noting that "patients who are denied hormone therapy can suffer from increased depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation and self-harm." MAJOR TRANSGENDER RULINGS The Supreme Court, which has a 6-3 conservative majority, has ruled against transgender rights in key cases since last year. It backed state laws banning transgender athletes from participating on female [USN:L1N4310YB TEXT:"sports teams"] at public schools including universities. It also allowed the administration to ban transgender people from the [USN:S0N3QZ02P TEXT:"military"] and bar [USN:S0N3V200K TEXT:"passport"] applicants from designating their gender identities for the document. And it let states ban gender-affirming [USN:S0N3RD05R TEXT:"medical care"] for transgender youths. Washington, DC-based US District Judge Royce Lamberth blocked the restrictions on federal prisoners in June, concluding that the policy is likely "arbitrary and capricious" in violation of a federal law governing agency procedures. The judge found that the Federal Bureau of Prisons disregarded its own evidence and experience and "reverse engineered" the measure in order to implement Trump's executive order. "With this opinion, the court has no intention of wading into the culture war being waged against transgender individuals," Lamberth wrote. The US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit on September 18 refused the administration's request to lift Lamberth's ruling. The Justice Department in its filing urged the Supreme Court to allow the Federal Bureau of Prisons to enforce its "decision to prioritize mental-health treatment, while discontinuing medically disputed and unproven sex-rejecting interventions." The Bureau of Prisons, the filing said, "reasonably considered its prior experience both in determining that such interventions are not medically necessary and in determining that security and prison-administration concerns independently justified a change in policy."

item.description:
Jaspreet Singh Aditya Soni
[２１日 ロイター] - 米電子商取引（ＥＣ）大手イーベイが、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米イーベイ、従業員9％削減へ　約1000人が対象 0:21 配信

2026年1月6日、ラスベガスで撮影。REUTERS/Steve Marcus

Jaspreet Singh　Aditya Soni

[２１日 ロイター] - 米電子商取引（ＥＣ）大手イーベイが、従業員の約９％を削減することが分かった。ジェイミー・イアンノーネ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が従業員に宛てたメモをロイターが確認した。業務を簡素化し、成長が最も速い分野に経営資源を振り向ける。

同社の広報担当者は２１日、人員削減を確認し、約１０００人が対象になると述べた。

２０２５年末の従業員数は１万２３００人だった。同社は業務効率化の一環として、２月にも従業員の約６％に当たる８００人を削減した。

イアンノーネ氏はメモで「今後の大きな機会を引き続き捉えるには、どこに注力し、投資するかについて慎重に選択する必要がある」と説明。対象の従業員には今後数日以内に通知するとした。

イーベイ株は取引序盤に約１％上昇した。

item.title: 再送-〔アングル〕マスク氏、テスラとスペースＸ統合に「多くのメリット」 株主投票がハードル
item.description:
(見出しの誤字を修正します)
Akash Sriram
[２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(見出しの誤字を修正します)

Akash Sriram

[２１日　ロイター] - 電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラを率いるイーロン・マスク氏は、同社と宇宙開発企業スペースＸの統合に「多くのメリットがある」との見方を示した。ただ、決定権はマスク氏にはなく、同氏が参加できない２つの特別委員会と、自身が「高いハードル」と呼ぶテスラの株主投票がその障害となっている。

多くのアナリストが不可避と見るこの統合には、こうしたジレンマが影を落としている。自らを「利害相反の当事者」と称するマスク氏は、両委員会はまだ条件で合意しておらず、市場が来年末までの合意成立を予想しているにもかかわらず、統合は確実ではないとの認識を示している。

フォーチュナ・インベストメンツのジャスタス・パーマー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「テスラとスペースＸの合併は理にかなうと思う。両社とも人工知能（ＡＩ）と自律システムへ急速に移行しており、大規模なインフラ事業を抱えているため、極めて戦略的だ」と述べた。

アナリストらによると、ＡＩや宇宙関連インフラへの巨額の設備投資が膨らめば、スペースＸのフリーキャッシュフローは圧迫されるものの、合併企業であればテスラとサービスを共有し、共同で資金調達することで、その負担を緩和できるという。

テスラの株主で資産運用会社ディープウォーター・アセット・マネジメントのマネージングパートナー、ジーン・マンスター氏はＸへの投稿で、「（統合が）これほど理にかなう最大の理由は、テスラがしていることをスペースＸが必要とし、スペースＸがしていることをテスラが必要としていることだ」と述べた。

＜ハードルはテスラ株主投票＞

マスク氏が合併を望む背景には、支配権の問題もある。同氏は複数議決権株式を通じてスペースＸの議決権の約８５％を保有している一方、テスラではその割合は約２０％にとどまる。

ＲＥＸファイナンシャルのリサーチ責任者ビル・バーミンガム氏は、合併によりマスク氏の議決権比率は約５７％になると試算する。ダイアレクティックの創業者ライアン・ズラー氏は、バークレイズが例示した参考水準である、テスラ株１株に対しスペースＸ株０．７株の交換比率で計算すると、その割合は５８％になるとみている。

マスク氏によると、テスラ側では投票された株式ではなく発行済み全株式の過半数の賛成を必要とするため、未行使の議決権は全て反対票として扱われる。アナリストらは、投票率をリスクと指摘しており、昨年の株主総会で投じられなかった、証券会社経由で保有される株式の議決権が取引成立の可能性に影響する要因になり得るとの見方を示している。

ｅトロのアジア太平洋地域（ＡＰＡＣ）主席アナリスト、ジョシュ・ギルバート氏は「１人の人物が両方を統括するような取引は、ガバナンスを巡って厳しい疑問を招くだろう」との見方を示した。

２１日午前の取引でテスラの株価は約３％上昇、スペースＸの株価は約９％上昇した。テスラは同日の米市場引け後に第３・四半期決算を発表する。

Oct 21 : AC Milan have thrown their support behind supporters planning to boycott Sunday's Serie A match at Udinese, saying the cost of away tickets places an unfair burden on travelling fans. Tickets for visiting supporters were listed at €65 ($73). In a statement, Milan said excessive pricing risked widening divisions between clubs and undermining efforts to strengthen the profile of Italian football. "The global appeal of Italian football depends heavily on the loyalty and passion of supporters of clubs like AC Milan," the club said. "Charging those same fans excessive prices for away games is not only unfair, but undermines the unity of the league at a time when Italian football needs to come together to compete against the Premier League and other European leagues."

Milan also urged Serie A to consider introducing a league-wide cap on away ticket prices, such as England's Premier League which has a cap of 30 pounds ($40). The club also warned they could adopt a reciprocal policy. Under the proposal, fans of clubs charging above-average prices to Milan supporters could face higher ticket costs when visiting San Siro, subject to league regulations, with additional proceeds "donated to Fondazione Milan to support charitable initiatives". "Italian football cannot grow stronger by treating supporters differently based on the size of their club," Milan added. Ticket pricing has been a longstanding issue for fan group Curva Sud, which boycotted Milan's away match at Juventus in 2023 in protest. The supporters' group renewed its complaints last season over prices charged for Milan's fixtures against Juventus and also accused Torino of overcharging visiting fans. item.title: Reports: Former Titan attempted to retrieve gun after fight in practice
item.description: Jordan Elliott, the defensive lineman released Tuesday by the Tennessee Titans, reportedly went to his car to retrieve a gun after an altercation in practice last Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jordan Elliott, the defensive lineman released Tuesday by the Tennessee Titans, reportedly went to his car to retrieve a gun after an altercation in practice last Thursday. Ordered to leave the field after a scuffle with right tackle JC Latham, Elliott took off his pads, left the facility and went to the players' lot where security cameras captured the scene, per multiple reports from A to Z Sports and KPRC2. Defensive lineman John Franklin-Myers reportedly talked Elliott down and no one was hurt. Elliott did not practice Friday due to "personal reasons" and was inactive for Sunday's 26-20 win against the Indianapolis Colts. After reviewing the footage, the Titans (1-5) opted to release the 28-year-old Elliott, who had signed a two-year, $8 million deal during the offseason. "I will stand on the table for Jordan's character. Unfortunately, rules are rules with regard to guns on property. And sometimes it's far greater than the knee-jerk reaction of kicking somebody when they're down," Titans coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday. "My message to 31 other teams would be if you need a helluva run-stopping D-tackle that can help you on a playoff run, give me a call. I'll tell you everything you need to know about him. He's a good man. "(He) had a terrible lapse in judgment that I recognize as a call for help more than a criminal act. It's unfortunate the way it went down. As far as Jordan's concerned and the locker room and all that, I think people see it differently here than the knee-jerk reaction of the world." Elliott appeared in the first five games (one start) and contributed 11 tackles across 138 total snaps (24 on special teams). A third-round draft pick by Cleveland in 2020, Elliott has collected 159 tackles, 14 quarterback hits and five sacks in 102 career games (65 starts) with the Browns (2020-23), San Francisco 49ers (2024-25) and Titans. --Field Level Media

item.title: FCC chair says broadcast networks could violate regulatory obligations by airing 'fake polls'
item.description: The chairman of the Federal Communications Commission said on Wednesday that US broadcast networks could violate their regulatory obligations by airing "entirely fake polls and suppression polls."
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The chairman of the Federal Communications Commission said on Wednesday that US broadcast networks could violate their regulatory obligations by airing "entirely fake polls and suppression polls." FCC Chair Brendan Carr said on X that ahead of the November midterm congressional elections there had been a significant surge in such polls "designed to do nothing more than interfere with the regular functioning of the electoral process and alter the normal patterns of voter turnout and enthusiasm." Carr did not provide evidence or detail which polls he was referring to. He added that the FCC took these issues seriously and suggested they could violate its news distortion rules. Comcast-owned (CMCSA.O) NBC, Skydance-owned (SKYD.N) CBS, ABC and Fox (FOXA.O) did not immediately comment. Carr has faced pressure from US President Donald Trump to crack down on US broadcasters and journalists. He did not name any specific polls in his statement that he believed were fake. The FCC did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether the commission would issue formal guidance on polls. Earlier this week, Reuters reported Trump's approval rating fell to a record low. Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in either of his presidential terms, according to a [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos poll"] that closed on Monday. Trump has repeatedly rejected the polls, as well as surveys that suggest Democrats are significantly ahead of Republicans in the midterm congressional elections, and called on Carr to punish journalists, including NBC's Kristen Welker. "I think it's fake polls. Polls mean something but a lot of the polls are rigged," Trump said Monday. The FCC says on its website news distortion "must involve a significant event and not merely a minor or incidental aspect of the news report." Broadcasters face potential penalties if they deliberately distort a factual news report while "expressions of opinion or errors stemming from mistakes are not actionable," the FCC says. “Pollsters who intentionally mislead the public should answer for it, but broadcasters who report publicly available polling data should never be punished when a poll is wrong," FCC Commissioner Anna Gomez, the sole Democrat on the three-member commission, said Wednesday. "FCC rules on news distortion or hoaxes do not apply to a station that reports this data in good faith.” Gomez said if a poll turned out to be incorrect -- which is not uncommon -- it was "not something that I would say fits within the news distortion policy." Carr in April ordered an unprecedented early license review for all eight of Disney's (DIS.N) company-owned ABC TV stations. The FCC also said earlier this year that late-night and daytime talk shows are no longer bona fide news programs that are exempt from equal time rules for interviews with political candidates. As a result, TV shows like ABC's "The View" and "Jimmy Kimmel Live" have stopped interviewing candidates on broadcast programs, Disney confirmed in a filing.

PARIS, Oct 21 : France's 42-man squad for November's home Nations Championship fixtures against Fiji, South Africa and Argentina, announced on Wednesday, is missing a string of injured players while coach Fabien Galthie has also named a few surprises. Eleven of the 23 players who claimed a 48–46 win over England in March to secure a second consecutive Six Nations title are not part of the squad, including flyhalf Matthieu Jalibert and fullback Thomas Ramos, both injured. The second-row pair of Thibaud Flament and Emmanuel Meafou is also missing, as are centre Pierre-Louis Barassi, hooker Julien Marchand and tighthead prop Demba Bamba. These absences have opened the door for surprises such as centre Jeremy Ward. The South African-born 30-year-old won't be eligible to play for France until 2027 due to residency rules but will serve as a training partner.

item.title: Irán exige a EE.UU. demostrar su voluntad de paz levantando el bloqueo naval
item.description: Irán condiciona una nueva oportunidad para la diplomacia a que Washington levante el bloqueo naval y dé señales creíbles de que busca una solución pacífica y duradera al conflicto.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Sykes
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Irán declaró que Estados Unidos debe levantar el bloqueo naval y demostrar que habla en serio sobre poner fin a la guerra por la vía diplomática, ya que el estancamiento de las negociaciones y las crecientes amenazas de ambas partes alimentan los temores de un retorno al conflicto abierto. “Irán está dispuesto a darle otra oportunidad a la diplomacia si vemos pruebas contundentes de un deseo sincero por parte de Estados Unidos de lograr una solución justa y honorable para poner fin de forma permanente a este conflicto”, escribió el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores, Abbas Araghchi, en un artículo de opinión publicado en el Financial Times. Ver más: El petróleo ronda los US$109 mientras ataques en Ormuz amenazan el suministro En una entrevista anterior con medios iraquíes, Araghchi instó a Estados Unidos a retomar el Memorando de Entendimiento de Islamabad, firmado en junio pero que fracasó rápidamente. Según ese acuerdo, Irán se comprometió a reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz y Estados Unidos debía levantar el bloqueo naval, liberar los fondos petroleros iraníes congelados y eliminar las sanciones. “Si cumplen estas condiciones, deben saber que el estrecho se abrirá por completo y, posteriormente, celebraremos nuevas rondas de negociaciones hasta alcanzar un acuerdo final”, afirmó. Estados Unidos ha mostrado poco interés en retomar el memorándum de junio. Desde su fracaso, Washington ha intensificado la presión económica sobre Teherán y ha vuelto a centrar su atención en el programa nuclear iraní, ampliando así la brecha entre ambas partes. Ver más: Trump amenaza con usar la “madre de todas las bombas”, pero no serviría contra búnkeres nucleares de Irán El precio del petróleo Brent superó los US$110 por barril el miércoles, debido a que los ataques contra buques en el estrecho continuaron interrumpiendo el tráfico marítimo a través de la vía fluvial. En las últimas semanas, el presidente estadounidense Donald Trump ha insinuado con frecuencia la amenaza de nuevos ataques contra Irán, sugiriendo que podría reanudar los bombardeos después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre. Esto ha provocado un estancamiento en las conversaciones y ha alimentado los temores entre los líderes iraníes de que, sin una garantía concreta por parte de Estados Unidos de reducir la tensión, Washington reanude las negociaciones con la intención de reanudar los ataques militares. En los últimos días, funcionarios iraníes han manifestado repetidamente la desconfianza entre ambas partes. Tanto la guerra de junio de 2025 como el conflicto actual fueron iniciados por Israel y Estados Unidos en medio de conversaciones de alto nivel entre Teherán y Washington. Ver más: Donald Trump dice que EE.UU. no atacará a Irán antes de las elecciones de noviembre “Nuestra nación hoy no confía en Estados Unidos y cree que si negociamos, nos atacarán de nuevo”, dijo el presidente Masoud Pezeshkian al jefe del ejército paquistaní, Asim Munir, uno de los principales mediadores entre ambas partes, durante una visita a Teherán el martes. En declaraciones realizadas el miércoles, Pezeshkian afirmó que Irán y Estados Unidos pueden “sentarse a dialogar” cuando Estados Unidos “reconozca los derechos del pueblo iraní y cese la intimidación y la agresión”. “Dado que la Casa Blanca no ha mostrado ninguna voluntad de llegar a un acuerdo sobre el camino a seguir, al tiempo que amenaza con más violencia, hay pocas razones para esperar progresos ahora”, escribió Araghchi en su artículo de opinión en el Financial Times. Las amenazas de Trump de reanudar los ataques aéreos contra la República Islámica han llevado a los funcionarios iraníes a prometer, a su vez, represalias contra la infraestructura de los países árabes del Golfo si son atacados. Ver más: No dejemos que la arrogancia impida poner fin a la guerra en Irán Los ataques estadounidenses e israelíes contra Irán han causado la muerte de miles de iraníes, mientras que decenas de personas han muerto en ataques con drones y misiles iraníes contra aliados estadounidenses ricos en petróleo en el Golfo Pérsico. La guerra generó una crisis en el suministro y los precios del combustible, ya que el transporte marítimo en el estrecho de Ormuz sigue gravemente afectado por la tensa situación. “A menos que cambien su forma de actuar rápidamente, pronto terminaremos el trabajo”, dijo Trump la semana pasada al respaldar al primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu en las próximas elecciones israelíes. Las especulaciones sobre planes de ataque conjuntos entre Estados Unidos e Israel aumentaron el martes después de que el secretario de Defensa estadounidense, Pete Hegseth, realizara una visita no anunciada a Israel y se reuniera con Netanyahu. Ver más: Príncipe heredero de Abu Dhabi invierte miles de millones de dólares para eludir control de Irán sobre el estrecho de Ormuz “Debemos completar la eliminación del régimen iraní”, dijo el líder israelí en un discurso pronunciado el martes en la inauguración de una universidad, según un comunicado del gobierno. “Porque mientras siga con vida, aunque esté maltrecha, magullada y derrotada, es tan fanática que intentará de nuevo hacer lo que hizo hace un año, algo que les impedimos: producir bombas nucleares y reconstruir el Eje.” Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Oct 21 : Fenerbahce players Marco Asensio and Nathan Ake have been sidelined with injuries, the Turkish club said on Wednesday. • Asensio underwent successful left knee surgery in Spain for a cartilage lesion and faces approximately three months of rehabilitation. • Ake suffered a moderate strain and swelling in his right leg during a match against Slavia Prague in the Champions League. • Fenerbahce played a 2-2 draw at home against the Czech side on Tuesday. • Ake underwent an MRI scan at Atasehir Medicana Hospital and is expected to miss approximately three weeks.
