item.title: Pentagon hit with class action over data breach affecting millions of military members
item.description: The US Defense Department is facing a class action lawsuit alleging it failed to protect sensitive personally identifiable information from a cyber breach that exposed data belonging to millions of current and former military members.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella, Raphael Satter
item.content:encoded: The US Defense Department is facing a class action lawsuit alleging it failed to protect sensitive personally identifiable information from a cyber breach that exposed data belonging to millions of current and former military members. The lawsuit , filed on Monday in federal court in Washington, said the breach last year at the Defense Department’s Defense Manpower Data Center left Social Security numbers, dates of birth and other military personnel information exposed for months. The Pentagon showed “flagrant disregard for the privacy interests of servicemembers and other military-adjacent individuals,” the lawsuit said. The two plaintiffs, a current and a former Marine, aim to represent a class of more than three million US servicemembers. They are seeking damages of more than $5 million. The Pentagon and lawyers for the plaintiffs did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The data breach was disclosed last month around the time of the [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"recent hack"] of the Federal Bureau of Investigation, which compromised Social Security numbers, job information and other sensitive data belonging to thousands of employees. Reuters reported earlier this month that the [USN:L6N45S01A TEXT:"bureau had removed"] an Accenture contractor for allegedly failing to properly update a software platform ahead of the hack. In the Pentagon lawsuit, the intruders allegedly exploited a vulnerability in a personnel-records file-sharing system, allowing access to unencrypted personal data. Other federal agencies in recent years have been hit with cyber breaches. In 2022, the US Office of Personnel Management agreed to pay [USN:L1N31F1V3 TEXT:"$63 million"] to resolve a class action lawsuit filed on behalf of millions of US employees. The case is Tristyn Edwards et al v. US Department of War, US District Court, District of Columbia, No. 1:26-cv-03667. item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat vor mittlerweile täglichen hybriden Angriffen Russlands auf Deutschland gewarnt und gleichzeitig eine Kapitulation der Ukraine abgelehnt. "Meine größte Sorge ist im Moment nicht unsere Wirtschaft, nicht die Europäische Union, nicht Amerika und nicht China", sagte Merz am Mittwoch beim Berlin Global Dialogue (BGD). "Meine größte Sorge sind die Auswirkungen Russlands auf unsere Gesellschaft und die Art und Weise, wie es ihnen gelingt, unsere Gesellschaften zu destabilisieren." Man erlebe permanent Angriffe Russlands und müsse widerstandsfähig werden. Die fortwährenden Desinformationen aus Moskau würden auch noch von einer Partei geschürt, sagte er in Anspielung auf die AfD. Deshalb sei auch klar, warum Deutschland die Ukraine weiter in ihrem Abwehrkampf gegen den russischen Angreifer unterstütze. "Das ist nicht nur ein Krieg in der Ukraine. Das ist ein grundlegender Angriff auf die gesamte politische Ordnung, die wir nach 1990 erreicht haben", sagte er. Mit Blick auf die neuen Russland-Avancen von US-Präsident Donald Trump fügte der Kanzler hinzu: "Eine Kapitulation – oder gar eine bedingungslose Kapitulation der Ukraine – kommt nicht infrage. Denn das wäre eine Kapitulation von uns allen." Deutschland und die Europäer unterstützten die Ukraine im eigenen Interesse. Regierungssprecher Stefan Kornelius bestätigte, dass der außen- und sicherheitspolitische Berater des Kanzlers bei den Gesprächen in Oslo zwischen dem US-Sondergesandten Steve Witkoff, dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj, dem norwegischen Ministerpräsidenten Jonas Gahr Støre und dem finnischen Präsidenten Alexander Stubb anwesend gewesen sei. Für die Bundesregierung sei klar, dass es keine Vereinbarung über die Köpfe der Ukraine und der Europäer hinweg geben könne.

item.title: Anthropic e editoras musicais apresentam argumentos em processo sobre treinamento de IA
item.description: A juíza federal Eumi Lee, de San Jose, na Califórnia, Estados Unidos, ouvirá nesta quarta-feira os argumentos relativos a uma defesa fundamental da Anthropic em uma ação judicial por direitos autorais movida por editoras musicais, incluindo a Universal Music Group , sobre o uso de letras de músicas para treinar seu chatbot Claude.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: A juíza federal Eumi Lee, de San Jose, na Califórnia, Estados Unidos, ouvirá nesta quarta-feira os argumentos relativos a uma defesa fundamental da Anthropic em uma ação judicial por direitos autorais movida por editoras musicais, incluindo a Universal Music Group (UMG.AS) , sobre o uso de letras de músicas para treinar seu chatbot Claude. O processo das editoras e outros semelhantes giram em torno da questão de saber se os sistemas de IA fazem “uso justo” de material protegido por direitos autorais ao utilizá-lo para criar novos conteúdos. A forma como juízes como Lee se pronunciarão sobre a defesa do uso justo provavelmente determinará o destino de dezenas de ações judiciais de alto risco movidas por autores, veículos de notícias, artistas visuais e outros contra gigantes da tecnologia -- incluindo Anthropic, OpenAI e Meta -- em relação ao treinamento de suas IAs. Dois outros juízes do norte da Califórnia que já se pronunciaram sobre a questão, que é acompanhada de perto, apresentaram opiniões divergentes sobre se o treinamento de IA generativa, de modo geral, constitui uso justo de material protegido por direitos autorais -- o que isentaria as empresas de tecnologia de responsabilidade pelo uso, sem permissão, de milhões de obras protegidas por direitos autorais para treinar seus sistemas. O juiz federal aposentado William Alsup apoiou a Anthropic no ano passado em seu argumento de que o treinamento de IA da empresa constituía uso justo de livros. Dois dias depois, o juiz federal Vince Chhabria decidiu a favor da Meta em um processo semelhante, mas alertou que o treinamento de IA “em muitas circunstâncias” não seria considerado uso justo. No caso que está sendo julgado por Lee, as editoras musicais UMG, Concord e ABKCO processaram a Anthropic em 2023, alegando que o uso de suas letras para treinar o Claude a responder a comandos humanos infringiu seus direitos autorais em centenas de canções de artistas como Beyoncé, Rolling Stones e Beach Boys. A Anthropic argumentou que o treinamento de sua IA faz uso transformativo das letras das músicas para “ajudar o Claude a compreender a linguagem humana e possibilitar o progresso e a produtividade na ciência, nos negócios e na educação”. “Permitir que os detentores de direitos autorais vetem uma tecnologia tão transformadora seria ignorar o mandato da Suprema Corte de que o objetivo principal dos direitos autorais não é recompensar o autor, mas servir ao público”, afirmou a Anthropic. As editoras argumentaram perante o tribunal que o uso de suas letras pela Anthropic não é justo, pois permite que o Claude gere novas letras que diluem o mercado para suas obras. “O Claude está sendo usado para proliferar letras de músicas geradas por IA em grande quantidade, e essas músicas criadas com ferramentas como o Claude estão saturando as plataformas de streaming e até mesmo subindo nas paradas da Billboard”, afirmaram as editoras em um documento judicial apresentado em março.

item.title: El petróleo ronda los US$109 mientras ataques en Ormuz amenazan el suministro
item.description: Los ataques a buques en el estrecho de Ormuz mantienen la incertidumbre sobre el suministro energético, aunque los flujos de crudo siguen elevados.
item.dc:creator: Kanoko Matsuyama, Alex Longley
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El petróleo registró pocos cambios, mientras los ataques en el estrecho de Ormuz siguen amenazando el suministro mundial, aunque el flujo de crudo por esta vía marítima se mantiene sólido. El Brent cotizaba cerca de los US$109 por barril, tras una sesión volátil el martes en la que el precio del crudo osciló en un rango de más de US$6. Ver más: S&P 500 sube impulsado por SpaceX y la inteligencia artificial, pese a la presión del petróleo La Organización de Operaciones de Comercio Marítimo del Reino Unido (UKMTO), una unidad de la Armada británica, informó que recibió un reporte sobre un buque alcanzado cerca de Omán. También reportó que otra embarcación fue atacada cerca de Irak el martes. Mientras tanto, el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Irán escribió en el Financial Times que hay pocas razones para esperar avances en el conflicto. En las últimas semanas, Teherán ha intensificado el ritmo de los ataques, con un número creciente de ellos dirigidos a las salas de máquinas de los buques, lo que subraya el riesgo constante para el transporte marítimo en la región. Sin embargo, el flujo a través del estrecho de Ormuz se ha mantenido elevado. Ver más: ¿Cuáles son los países que más petróleo producen en América Latina? El secretario de Estado estadounidense, Marco Rubio, declaró el martes que el petróleo que fluye por este paso estratégico se acerca a los niveles previos a la guerra. El seguimiento exacto de la cantidad de barriles que cruzan la vía fluvial se ha vuelto complicado debido a que los barcos apagan sus transpondedores, pero los datos de las empresas de inteligencia Kpler y Vortexa muestran que las exportaciones desde el Medio Oriente en general han aumentado desde el verano y que los ataques de Irán no han reducido drásticamente los flujos. “Un elevado volumen de exportaciones no implica necesariamente menores riesgos”, afirmó Arne Lohmann Rasmussen, analista jefe de A/S Global Risk Management. “El transporte marítimo sigue expuesto a ataques, mientras que las tarifas de flete y las primas de seguros, excepcionalmente altas, encarecen el transporte de petróleo”. Los futuros del Brent se han disparado cerca de un 80% este año debido a que la escalada de los conflictos en Medio Oriente y entre Rusia y Ucrania interrumpe el suministro energético, con un aumento aún mayor de los precios de los productos refinados. Los renovados ataques contra buques cisterna e infraestructura energética ponen de manifiesto el persistente riesgo geopolítico, incluso con la recuperación del flujo en el Golfo Pérsico, mientras que los costes de transporte marítimo se han disparado a niveles estratosféricos. Sin embargo, existen indicios de que los mercados físicos en algunas partes del mundo están empezando a enfriarse. Ver más: Goldman Sachs plantea tres escenarios que definirán el precio del petróleo en 2027 A medida que aumentan los flujos a través de Medio Oriente, un índice de referencia clave en la región ha caído a su nivel más bajo en tres meses. Al mismo tiempo, los operadores afirman que los altos costos de envío hacen que el petróleo estadounidense no se transporte tan lejos, lo que impulsa una mayor oferta hacia Europa y presiona el precio del crudo Brent físico. En Estados Unidos, el presidente Donald Trump busca reducir los precios de la energía antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato del próximo mes. Entre las medidas adoptadas se incluyen la exención de aranceles vinculados a los envíos de energía rusos, la firma de un acuerdo de exportación de diésel con Moscú y la autorización de la venta de petroleros sancionados para que puedan volver a operar en rutas marítimas legítimas. A medida que estos esfuerzos se ponen en marcha, algunos operadores se han volcado en las apuestas bajistas con opciones. El martes, se negociaron más opciones de venta sobre el Brent de ICE que nunca, y los operadores apostaron por una caída por debajo de los US$100 en los próximos meses. Ver más: La AIE acuerda completar la liberación pendiente de 100 millones de barriles de petróleo Mientras tanto, continúan las conversaciones para poner fin al conflicto entre Estados Unidos e Irán, pero los informes que indican que un acuerdo está cerca son inexactos, según un diplomático involucrado en las negociaciones. Un informe anterior, aún sin confirmar, hizo que el precio del petróleo cayera desde máximos de cinco meses el martes, con el Brent llegando a desplomarse hasta un 3,3% antes de recuperar parte de las pérdidas. Los datos sobre las reservas de Estados Unidos se publicarán el miércoles. El Instituto Americano del Petróleo, financiado por la industria, informó el martes que las reservas de crudo estadounidenses disminuyeron en 4,9 millones de barriles la semana pasada, según un documento al que tuvo acceso Bloomberg. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Indian court orders release of 'Cockroach' movement leaders, media say
item.description: An Indian court on Wednesday ordered the release of two cockroach movement leaders, local media reported, after they were detained last week for demonstrating at a historic protest venue in violation of a ban.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Indian court on Wednesday ordered the release of two [USN:L6N46206J TEXT:""cockroach" movement"] leaders, local media reported, after they were detained last week for demonstrating at a historic protest venue in violation of a ban. A local court in the Indian capital of New Delhi ordered the release of Cockroach Janta Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das late on Wednesday, legal website Live Law said Das and Ranka were among 14 people who [USN:L6N46006T TEXT:"scaled barricades"] on October 13 to enter the Jantar Mantar observatory in central Delhi, a day after it was removed from a list of designated protest sites The group unfurled the national flag and chanted slogans demanding the chief election commissioner's resignation, before police detained them, with a court later [USN:L6N46006T TEXT:"sending them to prison"] for five days. On Monday, their prison stay was [USN:L6N4650FZ TEXT:"extended "]for two more days The youth-led CJP, opposition parties and left-wing student organisations have held several protests this month demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar quit over a revision of voter lists they say favours Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party The Election Commission has denied favouring any party and said wrongly deleted voters can re-enrol, while the BJP has accused rivals of trying to undermine democracy by wrongly questioning legitimate electoral processes The founder of the CJP, Abhijeet Dipke, was [USN:L1N46300N TEXT:"separately detained"] on Friday and released a day later for trying to lead another protest rally in New Delhi

item.title: プーチン氏、中国首相と会談 中ロ関係の発展強調
item.description: [モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２１日、ロシアを訪問している中国の李強首相と会談し、両国の関係は順調かつ力強く発展しているとの認識を示した。ロシア国営タス通信が報じた。

ロシア通信（ＲＩＡ）によると、プーチン氏は中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議の期間中に、中国の習近平国家主席と会談する機会があるとの見方を示した。

ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官はこれまで、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席が来月のＡＰＥＣ首脳会議に合わせて３者会談を行う可能性に言及。トランプ大統領も中ロ首脳との３者会談に前向きな姿勢を示している。

item.title: PHP developers issue updates to fix vulnerabilities, says flaw was found in 2024
item.description: Developers of the PHP programming language said a set of new updates fixing two previously identified critical vulnerabilities was now live, and acknowledged a delay in addressing a previously identified flaw.
item.dc:creator: A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: Developers of the PHP programming language said a set of new updates fixing two previously identified critical vulnerabilities was now live, and acknowledged a delay in addressing a previously identified flaw. Government websites in Europe and elsewhere [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"went offline"] on Wednesday after the disclosure of critical vulnerabilities in PHP sent website operators around the world scrambling to protect their systems. PHP underpins large parts of the internet and the vulnerabilities had raised concerns that a significant number of websites could be vulnerable to attack. The developers issued four patches to address two "critical" vulnerabilities that could allow hackers to execute code on vulnerable systems. It said users were strongly encouraged to update immediately. The PHP Foundation, which oversees development and maintenance of the software, said in a blog post that a security researcher in 2024 found the first signs of a flaw that led to one of the vulnerabilities, but that the issue was "theorized, but no concrete vectors were found and other concrete issues with clear impact overshadowed these concerns." The delay in addressing the flaw "was a structural failure," the foundation said. The programming language's developers had earlier said they had identified two critical vulnerabilities and urged users to update their sites as soon as a fix was released. Security experts warned that hackers would quickly reverse engineer the patches and race to exploit unpatched systems. The US National Security Agency said in a statement that the vulnerabilities "often provide a direct path to the server's file system or database," and that if an immediate update was not feasible, organizations should take systems offline for full mitigation. The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) said in an advisory that organizations "should immediately update" their PHP installations. "While CISA has not observed exploitation of these vulnerabilities as of the time of publication, they pose a risk to organizations if left unpatched," the agency said in an advisory .

item.title: ロシア、米・ウクライナとの3者協議再開へ 11月アブダビ開催の公算
item.description: [モスクワ／サンクトペテルブルク／ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ／サンクトペテルブルク／ワシントン　２１日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２１日、ウクライナ和平に向けた米国仲介の協議を早ければ来月にも再開することで合意した。米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談後にロシア大統領府が明らかにした。

ロシア大統領府によると、新たな協議はロシア、米国、ウクライナの実務レベルで行われる見通しで、戦争終結後のロシアとウクライナの安全保障の確保が主要議題になる。開催地としてアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビが検討されており、１１月１０日、もしくはそれ以降に実施される可能性があるという。

米政府当局者も、米国が提案した実務レベルの３者協議の開催をロシアが受け入れたと明らかにした。こうした協議は今年２月以降行われていない。

ウィットコフ氏は２０日にノルウェーの首都オスロでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領、ノルウェーのストーレ首相、フィンランドのストゥブ大統領と会談した後、プーチン氏と２１日にロシア第２の都市サンクトペテルブルクで会談。プーチン氏とウィットコフ氏の会談は約３時間に及んだ。

ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官によると、ウィットコフ氏はゼレンスキー氏との協議の内容をプーチン氏に説明。欧州諸国とウクライナの姿勢について「新たなアプローチや新たな論点が示された」と報告したものの、「ウクライナを巡る危機の解決という観点では有益な内容は多く含まれていなかった」との認識を示したという。

プーチン氏はウィットコフ氏との会談で、米ロ首脳が今月９日に合意したロシア産ディーゼル（軽油）を巡る合意の履行についても協議。イラン情勢についても話し合い、ウシャコフ氏によると、プーチン大統領は外交による解決の余地は依然として十分に残されているとし、イランを巡る問題の政治的、外交的解決策を模索する取り組みを今後も支援する用意があることを改めて確認した。

このほか、来月に中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせ、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席が会談を実施する可能性についても協議された。ロシア大統領府によると、中国は米ロ中の首脳会談が実現すれば史上初となるとして、すでに準備に着手している。

item.title: Explosion injures four people in Greek capital
item.description: Two police officers and two members of the public were injured in an explosion at a building in central Athens, Greek police said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Two police officers and two members of the public were injured in an explosion at a building in central Athens, Greek police said on Wednesday. All four were taken away in ambulances, police said in a statement. A police official who declined to be named said the explosion occurred when officers reached the building in the area of Kolonos and picked up a backpack thought to contain drugs. Police had earlier received a call from a resident and the manager of the building notifying them of the suspected drugs at the building's entrance. They later found parts of an explosive device. The bomb went off as police inspected the backpack and was potentially activated remotely, a second police official said. The manager was also injured in the blast, which police are not treating as a terrorist act, the first police official added. The homicide unit is leading the investigation.

item.content:encoded:
経産省、来年からＥＶ補助6─8割に減額　予算内で制度維持へ 10/21 22:58 配信

電気自動車の充電設備。２００９年７月、神奈川県横須賀市で撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Yuriko Nakao）

Maki Shiraki

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 経済産業省は２１日、電気自動車（ＥＶ）など電動車の購入を促す補助金を来年から減額すると発表した。購入後に購入者が受け取れる補助金額を、現行の６割─８割程度に抑える。当初の想定より需要が強く、補助額を引き下げて予算内で制度を継続できるよう見直した。

来年１月１日以降に新車登録する車両から適用する。ＥＶの補助金は最大で１２５万円だったが、来年からは最大７５万円に減る。軽自動車のＥＶでは５５万円が４４万円に、プラグインハイブリッド車（ＰＨＶ）は８０万円が４８万円に、燃料電池車は１４５万円が８７万円にそれぞれ引き下がる。

車両に対する補助金とは別に、環境負荷の低減に向けた鋼材の導入に関する自動車メーカーの取り組みに応じて決める加算額も、軽のＥＶが最大３万円から１万８０００円に、それ以外の電動車は最大５万円から３万円に減額する。

政府は２０２５年度補正予算に、約１１００億円を補助分として計上していた。

FAST

Oct 21 : Former world number one Mark Allen said he spent 10 weeks in a mental health clinic before being discharged so he could play in the Northern Ireland Open, his first event in nearly six months after a devastating semi-final loss at the World Championship. The 40-year-old Northern Irishman, who was ranked world number one in 2024, missed a match-winning black in his epic semi-final against eventual champion Wu Yize in May. Allen returned to action this week at the Northern Ireland Open in Belfast, where he lost in the first round to his old friend Jordan Brown, after which he said he had been considering retirement while in a "bad place". However, the former Open champion had said he did not want his last match to be remembered for that semi-final at the Crucible and only took part as he was drawn against his friend Brown.

"I have been in a mental health clinic for the last 10 weeks, finally discharging so I could attempt to play in Belfast," Allen wrote on X on Wednesday. "I owed that to my family, in particular my daughter to see me play for what could be the last time. "I'm not ok, but I'm ok in that itself. I've been much worse in the last few months than you saw yesterday. I literally didn't see a future in anything." Allen credited his daughter, therapists, staff and other patients with helping him through "some really dark days" at the clinic. "I see the light now that I couldn't see before but I do now. I also know it won't happen overnight. I'm a work in progress," he added. "My fight and determination on the table has always been there for ones to see. I need to show those same fighting qualities off it now for a while." Brown expressed hope Allen would reconsider retirement after beating him for the first time in his career. "The first words I said to him today was it was great to see him back and we had a big cuddle. It is tough to see him going through that," he said after Tuesday's match. "I have no doubt he will come back. Snooker is his love, he is absolutely brilliant and he is a top bloke. I wish him all the best."

Source: Reuters

item.title: トルコ・カタールなど4カ国が防衛協定署名、軍事生産で連携＝国防省
item.description: [アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] - トルコ、カタール、パキスタン、インドネシアの４カ国は２１日、防衛協力の推進と防衛能力の強化を目的とする協定に署名した。トルコ国防省が明らかにした。

同省は声明で、４カ国はカタールの首都ドーハで「バドル覚書」に署名し、協力をさらに深化させ、パートナーシップを発展させる意思を示したと述べた。

同省は「この協定は経済的にも極めて重要である」とした上で、軍事生産における協力促進、軍事能力の向上、技術的な軍事訓練や研究開発における連携支援を目指すものだと説明。

「各国独自の軍事生産能力を活用することで、協力と統合を促進し、防衛産業の能力を向上させ、同盟国や友好国のニーズに応えることが可能になる」と述べた。

北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）で２番目の規模の軍と、強固な防衛産業を有するトルコは、イラン戦争を背景に、自国の軍事基地を置くカタールをはじめとする湾岸諸国の防衛力強化を支援してきた。８月には、核保有国であるパキスタンおよびサウジアラビアと相互防衛協定を締結した。

item.title: Bajan páginas web de Gobiernos después de que la IA detecta fallos críticos para Internet
item.description: Páginas web de Gobiernos en Europa y otras más quedaron fuera de servicio el miércoles, después de que se revelaron vulnerabilidades críticas en un lenguaje de programación muy usado, lo que llevó a los administradores de los sitios a tomar medidas urgentes para proteger sus sistemas.
item.dc:creator: Rajveer Pardesi, Raphael Satter, Leo Marchandon, Kanjyik Ghosh
item.content:encoded: Páginas web de Gobiernos en Europa y otras más quedaron fuera de servicio el miércoles, después de que se revelaron vulnerabilidades críticas en un lenguaje de programación muy usado, lo que llevó a los administradores de los sitios a tomar medidas urgentes para proteger sus sistemas. Los desarrolladores del lenguaje de programación PHP publicaron el miércoles nuevas correcciones urgentes para las vulnerabilidades que llevaban años ocultas en su software hasta que fueron descubiertas mediante inteligencia artificial, y recomendaron "a todos los usuarios que actualicen inmediatamente". Ante los reportes de que piratas informáticos ya estaban aprovechando estas fallas para acceder a los sitios web, agencias gubernamentales de toda Europa se sumaron a quienes desconectaron sus sitios web como medida de precaución. Dado que la corrección ya es pública y las herramientas de inteligencia artificial son capaces de realizar ingeniería inversa del fallo con poco esfuerzo, los expertos dijeron que se preparaban para una ola de intrusiones, ya que los hackers se apresuraban a adelantarse a los parches. PHP, un lenguaje que se remonta a principios de la década de 1990 y que significaba "Personal Home Page", sustenta gran parte de Internet, lo que suscita la preocupación de que un número significativo de sitios web pueda ser vulnerable a los ataques. "Todos los servidores que utilicen cualquier versión de PHP lanzada en los últimos 20 años serán vulnerables", dijo Tiffany Farriss, directora ejecutiva interina de la Asociación Drupal. "Este problema afecta a la mayor parte de Internet". Las agencias de ciberseguridad de Europa, Australia, Japón y el Reino Unido han instado a los usuarios de PHP a actualizar el software de inmediato o a desconectar sus sitios web hasta que se puedan aplicar los parches. La propia agencia de ciberseguridad neerlandesa se desconectó de la red, alegando que lo había hecho como medida de precaución debido a las vulnerabilidades. El administrador de la enciclopedia en línea Wikipedia también anunció que había desconectado un número no especificado de sistemas hasta que puedan parcharse de forma segura. FALLO DETECTADO CON IA El fallo en PHP se descubrió usando inteligencia artificial, según explicó en una entrada de blog la empresa de ciberseguridad Wiz, de (GOOGL.O) , propiedad de Alphabet. Las vulnerabilidades permanecieron ocultas en el código fuente de PHP durante más de una década y habría sido extraordinariamente complicado para un hacker humano aprovecharlas, según la entrada. "Antes de la IA, este trabajo manual habría sido difícil de llevar a cabo y aún más difícil ampliarlo", señaló. "Con la IA, esto ya no supone un obstáculo". Wiz explicó que su investigación se basó en Wiz Atlas, su herramienta autónoma de investigación de vulnerabilidades basada en IA, así como en Gemini 4 Argon de Google y GPT-5.6 Sol de OpenAI. Wiz señaló que coordinó con el equipo de PHP, OpenAI y la empresa de ciberseguridad Calif el descubrimiento de la vulnerabilidad y la verificación del parche. La empresa señaló que también colaboró con Google Cloud, Cloudflare (NET.N) , AWS de Amazon (AMZN.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Automattic (operador de WordPress.com) y otras empresas como Fastly (FSLY.O) , Akamai (AKAM.O) , Imperva y Vercel para proteger a los clientes y preparar medidas de mitigación. En un comunicado, la Casa Blanca dijo que tuvo conocimiento de la vulnerabilidad el viernes. "Este descubrimiento demuestra exactamente por qué el liderazgo estadounidense en SI (Súper Inteligencia) es tan crucial", dijo la Casa Blanca, refiriéndose al término preferido por el presidente Donald Trump para referirse a la inteligencia artificial. "Se trata de la innovación estadounidense que refuerza nuestra seguridad nacional". SOFTWARE CRÍTICO PHP es un lenguaje de programación utilizado para gestionar sitios web. Cuando un visitante carga una página, un servidor que ejecuta PHP ensambla el contenido y lo envía al navegador. Se trata de un software gratuito y de código abierto mantenido por voluntarios. La omnipresencia de PHP, que se ejecuta en aproximadamente el 75% de los sitios web cuyo lenguaje de programación puede identificarse, según el rastreador de tecnología web W3Techs, y a que las vulnerabilidades se consideran tan peligrosas, los expertos están preocupados por la existencia de un cantidad enorme de objetivos fáciles. Las campañas de piratería asistidas por IA, que han proliferado en las últimas semanas, no harían más que empeorar las cosas, dijo Lukasz Olejnik, investigador sénior visitante del King’s College de Londres. "La magnitud es enorme y, con la IA, la explotación podría producirse de forma instantánea y a gran escala", señaló Olejnik. El riesgo es especialmente grave para los pequeños sitios web gestionados por particulares u organizaciones con recursos técnicos limitados, a menudo en servicios de alojamiento compartido en los que los clientes no gestionan directamente los servidores subyacentes. Los expertos en seguridad señalaron que estos sitios podrían tardar más en aplicar los parches y seguirían expuestos mucho tiempo después de que las correcciones estén disponibles.

item.title: Masked men try to storm Libya's financial oversight body
item.description: Masked men in military uniform tried to storm the headquarters of Libya's financial oversight agency on Wednesday, in what the country's UN mission called an "unacceptable" attempt to install a senior employee by force.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Masked men in military uniform tried to storm the headquarters of Libya's financial oversight agency on Wednesday, in what the country's UN mission called an "unacceptable" attempt to install a senior employee by force. Footage posted on social media showed a group of men in beige fatigues and hats at the gate of the Tripoli offices of the Audit Bureau, which is charged with safeguarding public funds. It was not clear who was behind the attempt to storm the building. The Audit Bureau condemned the action and said in a statement it had suspended work until further notice "pending the resolution of the underlying causes and the restoration of appropriate, safe conditions for the resumption of work." "The Audit Bureau emphasizes that this decision is taken out of respect for the sanctity of state institutions, and to avoid any actions that might compromise their safety or independence," it said. Libya has known little stability since the 2011 NATO-backed uprising that ousted Muammar Gaddafi. The country has been split into rival eastern and western camps since 2014. Armed factions, some with official status, have long vied for control of territory and financial revenues in the Libyan capital, sometimes raiding institutional buildings and abducting staff. On Wednesday, the United Nations Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) said that "force and intimidation" had been used to try to install a disputed deputy head of the institution. "The use of force to impose appointments to sovereign institutions is wholly unacceptable and represents a grave threat to the rule of law and the independence and integrity of Libya's sovereign institutions," UNSMIL said in a statement. "Such actions are particularly concerning when directed at an independent oversight institution entrusted with safeguarding the use of public funds and ensuring accountability in the management of state resources," it said.

item.title: Brookings paper offers broad plan to shrink Fed balance sheet
item.description: The Federal Reserve can substantially shrink its balance sheet if it overhauls its rate control toolkit to provide liquidity on demand, if those alterations are in made in conjunction with rule changes that allow banks to hold lower levels of cash on hand, says a new paper published by the Brookings Institution.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: The Federal Reserve can substantially shrink its balance sheet if it overhauls its rate control toolkit to provide liquidity on demand, if those alterations are in made in conjunction with rule changes that allow banks to hold lower levels of cash on hand, says a new paper published by the Brookings Institution. The proposed roster of changes could allow the Fed to downsize overall holdings from their current $6.8 trillion level to around $4.5 trillion, with the proposed level of reserves in the financial system ebbing from around the $3 trillion mark to around $1 trillion, wrote Chris Hughes, Nonresident Fellow at the think tank’s Hutchins Center on Fiscal and Monetary Policy. The paper argues now is the time to consider bold change given that new Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh [USN:L6N42O0YN TEXT:"wants a smaller Fed balance sheet"] and has named a task force to consider ways to make that happen. “Opportunities to reset Fed operating systems do not come often,” Hughes wrote, adding “this moment should not be wasted.” If done, “The Fed’s footprint as a share of GDP would be smaller than at any point since 2008, and the interest paid to banks would fall by roughly two-thirds,” Hughes wrote, alluding to Fed interest costs on its balance that have led the central bank into an unprecedented period of [USN:L6N40D149 TEXT:"loss making"]. AMPLE TO ELASTIC? The key to making this happen is moving away from the Fed’s current system of so-called ample reserves, where it aims to keep the financial system flush with large amounts of cash, with control of short-term rates delivered through a complicated toolkit and periodic waves of central bank bond buying. The new system would be called “Elastic Reserves” and would be more responsive to market demand for cash, Hughes wrote. The ample reserves system developed over the years following the global financial crisis, which kicked off nearly 20 years ago. The Fed’s push then to near-zero interest rates drove it buy large amounts of bonds to provide economic stimulus and market stabilization. The Fed again bought bonds in large numbers during the COVID-19 pandemic, and collectively those purchases drove overall central bank holdings from just under a trillion dollars to a peak of $9 trillion in 2022, before the central bank began passively reducing its bond holdings. For many current Fed officials, while the levels of Fed holdings are large, ample reserves works in real world conditions. And a number of experts also reckon banks flush with cash are better prepared to deal with financial troubles when they arise. The system "has proven to be highly effective at delivering interest rate control and supporting the smooth functioning of core financial markets,” New York Fed leader John Williams said on Sept. 22 at a [USN:S0N4490DM TEXT:"conference at his bank"]. TOOLKIT TWEAKS Critics of the Fed’s large holdings, Warsh among them, believe that large Fed holdings of Treasury and mortgage bonds distort financial markets and put the institution too much in the place of setting longer-term borrowing levels. That said, Warsh has noted that the current regime has taken years to build and [USN:S8N40E0AX TEXT:"can’t be changed overnight"]. In his paper, Hughes noted “a large, fixed stock of reserves is not necessary to implement monetary policy effectively, and the Federal Reserve can reliably do so through a smaller structural stock backed by elastic lending capacity.” If the Fed puts less liquidity into the system, it should change the standing repo operations tool, which provides fast cash to eligible firms, to have no cap and a higher rate than the interest on reserves rate, while launching a “new” Term Liquidity Facility to auction off four-month funding against a broad range of collateral. The Discount Window would also remain in the mix for emergency lending and Fed holdings should be moved to Treasury bills and away from longer-dated holdings, among other proposed changes. It should also set a target for the Secured Overnight Financing Rate and stop targeting the federal funds rate, the paper said. Hughes writes this would echo how the Bank of England provides liquidity to markets while at the same time drawing on past liquidity facilities offered by the Fed. “The development of new facilities must be paired with policy changes to reduce structural reserve demand” and this can be done in part by changing the [USN:L6N42411E TEXT:"rules around banking regulation"] as well as how the Treasury manages its large-sized cash account at the Fed, the researcher said. “New liquidity facilities and policies to reduce reserve demand are necessary complements; neither effectively delivers a permanently smaller balance sheet without the other,” Hughes wrote. Huges also wrote he hopes the Fed balance sheet task force should “deliver a concrete blueprint” for contracting Fed holdings and not just a list of options. “Leadership from the Chair is critical, given the overlapping mandates and interlocking tools required to update the operating system,” Hughes added, while noting Congress could also legislate the change he thinks is needed.

item.title: India rate panel flags more hikes but wary of aggressive cycle, minutes show
item.description: Members of India's rate-setting panel indicated that further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation but stopped short of endorsing an aggressive tightening cycle over risks to economic growth, minutes of the committee's meeting released on Wednesday showed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Members of India's rate-setting panel indicated that further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation but stopped short of endorsing an aggressive tightening cycle over risks to economic growth, minutes of the committee's meeting released on Wednesday showed. The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% earlier this month, its first hike in nearly four years. It also shifted its stance to "calibrated tightening" from "neutral", with Governor Sanjay Malhotra saying that the shift essentially signalled that rate cuts were off the table. A sharp rise in oil prices due to the Middle East war and a deficient monsoon rain season have sparked a jump in food prices and stoked inflation worries, prompting markets to price in a little over 100 bps of hikes in the next 12 months. "There are increasing signs of generalisation of inflation," Malhotra said in the minutes. Domestic retail inflation (INCPIY=ECI) accelerated to a higher-than-expected 5.54% in September, nearing the central bank's 6% tolerance ceiling and strengthening the case for further hikes. The central bank expects inflation to average 6% in the ongoing October-December quarter, per its latest projections. Considering this, "one may not want to wait for more definitive evidence of generalisation, and instead be mindful of the fact that monetary policy works with a lag", Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said. "It is conceivable that a further increase in the policy rate might be needed to keep inflation low and inflationary expectations anchored." The central bank raised its average inflation forecast to 5.2% for the current financial year from 5% and nudged up its economic growth forecast by 40 bps to 7.1% at its policy review earlier this month. "The totality of information indicates a strong economic case at this time for tightening monetary policy," MPC member Saugata Bhattacharya said in the minutes. "At the same time, too rapid a policy rate adjustment risks constricting growth," he added. VIEWS DIFFER ON DEPTH OF HIKES However, the rate panel members and economists are split over the extent of tightening that may ultimately be needed. MPC members Nagesh Kumar and Ram Singh were both opposed to changing the monetary place stance, with Singh adding that the shift may signal an extended cycle of rate hikes — something that is not merited at the moment. "For now, there is a case for incremental, mild repo rate hikes, not high-for-long rates," Singh said in the minutes, pointing to how expectations of aggressive tightening can undermine demand even beyond rate-sensitive sectors. Economists at Barclays have forecast two more rate hikes in the current cycle while their counterparts at Goldman Sachs expect at least three more, spread over December to June 2027. HSBC, meanwhile, has forecast an outsized 50-bp increase in December alone. "I feel it is better to set aside the 'cautiousness bias' and act in a pre-emptive manner at this juncture rather than wait and watch," RBI Executive Director Indranil Bhattacharyya said in the minutes.

オープンＡＩのロゴ REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

Krystal Hu

[２１日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩは今後数週間以内に、最先端のＡＩモデルとコーディングエージェント「Codex」をグーグル・クラウドを通じて提供する。両社が２１日に発表した。競合する２社の関係が深まっているほか、主要なクラウドプロバイダーが最上位ＡＩモデルの主要ディストリビューターになりつつあることを示している。

この提携により、オープンＡＩの最新モデルがグーグル・クラウドの「Model Garden」に盛り込まれる。顧客は「グーグル・クラウド・マーケットプレイス」を通じてこれらのモデルを購入し、既存のクラウド利用契約を充当できるようになるという。

また、規制対象業界の顧客は、グーグル・クラウドのアクセス制御、データガバナンスツール・インフラストラクチャーを通じてオープンＡＩモデルにアクセスし、「エージェント型ＡＩワークフロー」を構築できるようになる。

グーグル・クラウドにとって、オープンＡＩのモデルを追加することは、自社製のモデルだけに頼るのではなく、顧客により幅広いサードパーティー製モデルを提供するという戦略を強化することになる。

PARIS, Oct 21 : The Dakar Rally will return to Africa for its 49th edition due to the situation in the Middle East and in particular in Saudi Arabia, where the race has been held since 2020, three people involved in the World Rally-Raid Championship told Reuters. According to the sources – two drivers and a team manager – the race will start in Europe with a prologue either in Spain or Portugal, before heading to Morocco for the remainder of the event, which is expected to feature around 12 stages  The Dakar Rally is scheduled to run from January 9 to 22. Race organisers Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO), the International Automobile Federation and International Motorcycling Federation did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.

The Middle East situation has forced organisers to adapt their plan amid escalating hostilities between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi movement, which has stepped up attacks on Saudi cities, airports and energy infrastructure. ASO unveiled the original route in May, with the start and finish in King Abdullah Economic City, but had recently been working on an alternative route in the north of the kingdom, two drivers and a team member told Reuters this month. However, the situation has deteriorated further, with a strike on Riyadh's international airport on October 10 killing at least 12 people and wounding more than 300. The Dakar Rally was initially scheduled to run from January 1 to January 15, with a record 5,320 km (3,306 miles) of timed stages planned for the 2027 edition, the race's eighth in Saudi Arabia. The event started in 1978 as a race from Paris and across the Sahara to the Senegalese capital in West Africa and has long been regarded as the world's toughest motorsport challenge. It was later staged in South America between 2009 and 2019, after leaving Africa for security reasons.

item.title: Players to face stricter anti-doping whereabouts rules from 2027
item.description: Oct 21 : Tennis players will lose a longstanding exemption from strict anti-doping whereabouts requirements during tournaments from January 2027, the International Tennis Integrity Agency (ITIA) said on Wednesday.• Changes to the World Anti-Doping Code require players in a sport's Registered Testing Pool (R
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Players to face stricter anti-doping whereabouts rules from 2027

FILE PHOTO: Three tennis balls are seen at Flushing Meadows, New York, United States, on September 6, 2026. REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz/File Photo

21 Oct 2026 08:29PM (Updated: 21 Oct 2026 08:37PM)

FAST

Oct 21 : Tennis players will lose a longstanding exemption from strict anti-doping whereabouts requirements during tournaments from January 2027, the International Tennis Integrity Agency (ITIA) said on Wednesday. • Changes to the World Anti-Doping Code require players in a sport's Registered Testing Pool (RTP) to provide a daily 60-minute testing window during competition from 2027, ending an exemption previously granted to tennis because of the unpredictability of players' schedules. • The ITIA, an independent body that protects fairness in the game, said that it would reduce the size of its RTP, moving around 80 per cent of players currently in the group to an expanded testing pool where the daily 60-minute requirement will not apply. • "Players who remain in the reduced RTP will be required to provide a daily 60-minute time slot like athletes in every WADA-compliant sport, both in and out of competition," the ITIA added.

• The number of players selected across both testing pools will be broadly consistent with the current testing pools, and testing frequency and volume are unlikely to change. • The new rules will also provide greater protection for players who can establish that a positive test was caused by contamination, including through medication, food or drink, environmental exposure or another person. • They will also provide greater flexibility in sanctions in certain circumstances, with rehabilitation-focused options for some recreational drug cases unrelated to sporting performance. • Players will be informed in November which pool they have been assigned to, though individual classifications will not be made public. • All players, regardless of their testing pool status, must provide a sample when requested by a doping control officer, with refusal carrying a potential ban of up to four years.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Egypt rejects Libyan approval of maritime deal with Turkey
item.description: Egypt's Foreign Ministry on Wednesday rejected the maritime boundaries deal that Libya's eastern parliament ratified with Turkey, saying in a statement that the ratification will have no legal impact on Cairo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Egypt's Foreign Ministry on Wednesday rejected [USN:S8N43R010 TEXT:"the maritime boundaries deal"] that Libya's eastern parliament ratified with Turkey, saying in a statement that the ratification will have no legal impact on Cairo. The deal approved on Tuesday is part of a years-old dispute over competing claims to sea borders and energy exploration rights in the eastern Mediterranean. "Egypt reaffirms that this memorandum is null and void ... possesses no legal effect," Egypt's Foreign Ministry said Israel said on Wednesday it "strongly" condemned the Libyan eastern parliament's approval, which also drew swift criticism from Greece "Regretfully, once again we see Turkey working to destabilise the east Mediterranean region," the Israeli Foreign Ministry said in a statement Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan rejected the criticism, saying the agreement was legitimate and that the Libyan parliament's ratification was simply a formality as the deal was already in effect for Ankara. "There are countries reacting to this. We know why they are reacting. Some are doing so because they need to, some really do have strategic problems with this issue. However, this is an entirely legitimate deal, both from a legal and a statutory perspective. There is no need to argue this," Fidan told state media in Brussels. The Libya-Turkey maritime deal was [USN:KBN1Y21VL TEXT:"originally agreed"] in 2019 by Libya’s internationally recognised government in Tripoli in the west, but the rival eastern administration under military commander Khalifa Haftar had withheld its approval for years Greece and Turkey, NATO allies but historic rivals, have disputed maritime borders in the Aegean Sea and the eastern Mediterranean Greece, Egypt and Cyprus have long been opposed to a [USN:L1N4660EB TEXT:"maritime-boundaries deal"] between Libya and Turkey, as they see it as an infringement on their own maritime claims

item.title: El dólar opera con tendencias mixtas mientras operadores esperan a la Fed
item.description: El dólar estadounidense cotizaba con tendencias mixtas el miércoles, mientras los operadores sopesaban los renovados riesgos de inflación impulsados por el petróleo y esperaban la reunión de la Reserva Federal de la próxima semana.
item.dc:creator: Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: El dólar estadounidense cotizaba con tendencias mixtas el miércoles, mientras los operadores sopesaban los renovados riesgos de inflación impulsados por el petróleo y esperaban la reunión de la Reserva Federal de la próxima semana. * "En realidad, esta mañana no hay un tema dominante en los mercados y creo que seguirá siendo así al menos hasta la próxima semana, cuando se celebre la reunión del FOMC", dijo Shaun Osborne, estratega jefe de divisas de Scotiabank. "Tenemos que hacernos una idea de cuál es la postura de la Fed". * La guerra en curso entre Estados Unidos e Irán ha aumentado los temores a que la inflación impulsada por el petróleo pueda afectar a la política de la Fed. * Los precios del petróleo subían más de 2 dólares después de que Irán dijo que había pocos motivos para esperar avances diplomáticos con Estados Unidos. El crudo Brent se sitúa cerca de máximos de cinco meses, y la caída de las reservas de crudo y productos derivados en Estados Unidos contribuyó a las subidas. * El dólar se debilitó la semana pasada a pesar de que los datos mostraron que la inflación de los precios al consumo en Estados Unidos se aceleró en septiembre. A los inversores les preocupa cuánto tiempo puede durar el auge de las acciones relacionadas con la IA. El optimismo sobre el sector ha respaldado al dólar al atraer capital hacia Estados Unidos y elevar las expectativas de crecimiento e inflación. * El índice dólar , que mide la cotización de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas que incluye al yen y al euro, caía un 0,03% a 101,76, mientras que el euro bajaba un 0,11% a 1,1224 dólares. * El euro se ha visto lastrado por las generalizadas protestas contra el Gobierno en Francia y por el deterioro de las perspectivas fiscales. El miércoles, los costos de financiación a 10 años de Francia alcanzaron máximos de 24 años. * La libra esterlina operaba estable tras haber subido anteriormente a raíz de los datos que mostraron que la inflación del Reino Unido aumentó más de lo esperado el mes pasado, lo que reforzaba los argumentos a favor de una subida de tasas de interés por parte del Banco de Inglaterra en noviembre. * Frente al euro, la libra alcanzó su nivel más alto en 17 meses. * El yen se apreciaba un 0,08%, a 158,04 unidades por dólar. El vicegobernador del Banco de Japón, Ryozo Himino, dijo que la inflación subyacente se situaba cerca del objetivo del 2% del banco central y que las condiciones financieras seguían siendo laxas, lo que apuntaba a un margen para un aumento de los costes de financiación.

item.title: 米特使がプーチン氏と会談、和平協議再開促す 新提案も提示
item.description: [サンクトペテルブルク（ロシア） ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[サンクトペテルブルク（ロシア）　２１日　ロイター] - 米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は２１日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と会談し、米国が仲介するウクライナとの和平協議の再開と、戦争終結に向けた新たな提案の検討を促した。

サンクトペテルブルクの宮殿で行われた会談は、ロシア側が善意の意思表示として、拘束していた米国人の元学校教師スティーブン・ハバード氏を解放する形で始まった。ウィットコフ氏がプーチン氏と対面で会うのは９回目。

プーチン氏は、トランプ米大統領のイラン対応を支援する意向を示した。ロシアはイランと数十年にわたる関係を持っているとし、その関係を利用してイラン核開発計画に対する米国の懸念に対処する用意があると繰り返し申し出たと指摘。米国の農家支援へ肥料の大量供給も可能だとウィットコフ氏に伝えたほか、１１月に中国でトランプ氏と会談する可能性について協議したいとも述べた。ロシア大統領府は、この会談に中国の習近平国家主席も参加する可能性を示唆している。

ウィットコフ氏はプーチン氏に「きょう実現したいことの一つは、ウクライナ、ロシア、米国による３カ国協議を再開できるかどうかについて、有意義な話し合いをすることだ」と表明。「きょう解決に至らなくても、次の一歩として何ができるかを話し合い、検討するだけでも重要だと思う。世界はその結果を待っている」と語った。

米国が仲介する和平協議が最後に開かれたのは２月で、その後、米国とイスラエルがイランとの戦争を開始した。

和平合意の条件を巡るウクライナとロシアの隔たりは依然として大きいが、トランプ氏は最近、何らかの合意に達するようウクライナへの圧力を強めている。２０日には、ウクライナは戦争を終わらせる時だと述べ、さもなければ「非常に悪いこと」に直面するとした。

＜新たな提案＞

プーチン氏は、故郷サンクトペテルブルクにある帝政時代の壮麗なコンスタンチン宮殿でウィットコフ氏を迎えた。ウクライナ東部ドネツク州の完全掌握や、ウクライナの北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）非加盟といった戦争の主要目標について、妥協する姿勢はほとんど示していない。

会談には、ロシア政府系投資ファンドを率いるドミトリエフ大統領特別代表も同席した。双方は戦争終結後の米ロ経済協力の可能性を強調した。

ウィットコフ氏は２０日、オスロでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領、フィンランドとノルウェーの首脳、欧州と北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）代表者らと協議、その翌日にンクトペテルブルク入りした。オスロでの協議は生産的で「ある程度の弾み」がついたと評価し、その内容をプーチン氏に説明すると述べた。

和平合意に向けたさまざまな案を記した文書を持参し、プーチン氏に検討してもらうと説明。トランプ氏の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏もいくつかの案を伝えたいと考えており、間もなく電話で会談に参加すると述べた。

米当局者によると、ウクライナはオスロでの協議に新たな案や提案を持ち込み、ロシアへの働きかけで足並みをそろえる上で「有意義な進展」があった。ウクライナの安全保障、戦後の経済計画、広範な欧州の安全保障体制など、「包括的な和平の枠組みの主な要素」が協議されたとという。

ゼレンスキー氏は２１日のＦＯＸニュースのインタビューで、オスロでのウィットコフ氏との協議は生産的だったとし、ロシアでの協議で前向きな成果が得られることに期待を表明、ウクライナ、米国、ロシアの首脳による協議を支持すると述べた。

＜悪化する米ウクライナ関係＞

米国とウクライナの関係は、トランプ氏が１０月初め、米国内の価格引き下げへロシアとの軽油輸出に関する合意を発表して以降、急激に悪化している。米国向けの最初のタンカーは２２日に出航する予定。

ウクライナは、一部の情報共有や軍事用衛星システム「スターシールド」の利用に支障が出ていると訴えている。ただ、ゼレンスキー氏は、２０日のオスロでの会合で、これらの問題を解決することで合意したと述べた。

item.title: Nvidia's Huang hails Europe's AI potential, flanked by robot ducks
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang believes that Europe's engineering expertise gives it an edge in physical AI and robotics, he said on Wednesday as the US tech giant announced expanded partnerships with European manufacturers and startups.
item.dc:creator: Toby Sterling, Hakan Ersen
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) CEO Jensen Huang believes that Europe's engineering expertise gives it an edge in physical AI and robotics, he said on Wednesday as the US tech giant announced expanded partnerships with European manufacturers and startups. "Every company in Europe will become an AI company," Huang said at Nvidia's GTC conference in [USN:L8N4650JJ TEXT:"Berlin"], which caps a European tour that has already taken him through [USN:L4N4600FN TEXT:"London"], Paris, Stockholm and Dublin. "No region has dedicated itself to making mechatronics, electronics and mechanical systems at the level of precision and craft as the European region." In a demonstration of Europe's AI creativity, Huang shared the stage with tiny duck-shaped, AI-trained robots developed by French startup Pollen Robotics in collaboration with Hugging Face, asking them to perform somersaults. Nvidia says it has committed nearly $10 billion to Europe's technology ecosystem. It has established an early lead in supplying the [USN:L6N4030AL TEXT:"processors"] and software needed for robotic 'brains', giving it a commercial interest in Europe's industry succeeding. Among partnerships announced on Wednesday, Germany's Agile Robots plans to produce 1,000 to 2,000 petite humanoids next year in collaboration with Nvidia, CEO Zhaopeng Chen told Reuters. Production is due to begin late this year. Huang said that Europe — often left behind by the US and Asia in the AI race and with no real home-grown player at the scale of an Nvidia, Anthropic or OpenAI — needed to make sure it was playing a central role. "To be part of this AI economy, you don't want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI. We could do all of that here in Europe," he said. Separately on Wednesday, Nvidia showcased a so-called new DSX POD design for factory-built data centre modules using its Vera Rubin platform. It said the modules could be deployed in as little as two weeks, down from six months. However, not all went to plan on stage. The Microducks showed that even with the power of AI, getting robots to follow instructions is not foolproof. Three promptly keeled over when Huang ordered them to take a nap, but the fourth needed extra persuasion. One appeared distracted and faced the wrong way as Huang wrapped up his speech. "Pay attention, stay focused," he told it sternly.

item.title: OpenAI to sell its top models on Google Cloud in latest enterprise push
item.description: Oct 21 : OpenAI will make its frontier artificial intelligence models and Codex coding agent available through Google Cloud in the coming weeks, the companies said on Wednesday, deepening ties between two rivals and underscoring how major cloud providers are becoming key distributors of top AI models.The part

OpenAI to sell its top models on Google Cloud in latest enterprise push

FAST

Oct 21 : OpenAI will make its frontier artificial intelligence models and Codex coding agent available through Google Cloud in the coming weeks, the companies said on Wednesday, deepening ties between two rivals and underscoring how major cloud providers are becoming key distributors of top AI models. The partnership will bring OpenAI's latest models such as GPT-6 Astra to Google Cloud's Model Garden. It will allow customers to buy them through Google Cloud Marketplace and use existing cloud spending commitments for the purchases, according to a company blog post, as OpenAI tries to sell its models to more enterprise customers.  It will also allow customers in regulated industries to access OpenAI models through Google Cloud's access controls, data governance tools and infrastructure to build so-called agentic AI workflows. Alphabet's Google has become the latest major hyperscaler to offer OpenAI models to its customers, after OpenAI’s exclusive distribution arrangement with Microsoft expired in April.

OpenAI has since expanded distribution to Amazon Web Services and now to Google Cloud, each a major hyperscaler vying for AI market share. The deal adds another layer to an increasingly complex relationship between OpenAI and Google, which compete in core AI products and search even as the economics of building and deploying large models push them toward cooperation. Google has moved to position its cloud unit as a neutral platform offering customers a broader choice of models, after it struck a cloud deal with OpenAI to offer it more computing capacity last year.  For Google Cloud, adding OpenAI's models strengthens a strategy of offering customers a wider range of third-party models rather than relying only on its own. Thomas Kurian, chief executive of Google Cloud, has told Reuters in a previous interview that the Google cloud platform is an open platform and it welcomes any model popular with developers in it.  The arrangement also fits a broader industry shift in which hyperscalers are becoming the main commercial channels for frontier AI labs. Cloud providers usually take a cut from sales through its platform. Anthropic, an OpenAI rival backed by Amazon and Google, has seen 47 per cent of its 2025 revenue coming from cloud providers Amazon and Google's cloud platforms, according to its IPO filing reviewed by Reuters.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Cobre baja por aumento de existencias y menos preocupación sobre suministro
item.description: Los precios del cobre cayeron el miércoles tras un aumento de las existencias y un descenso de las preocupaciones sobre el suministro, a pesar de las ofertas récord de prima por parte de los productores para las entregas físicas del próximo año.
item.dc:creator: Eric Onstad
item.content:encoded: Los precios del cobre cayeron el miércoles tras un aumento de las existencias y un descenso de las preocupaciones sobre el suministro, a pesar de las ofertas récord de prima por parte de los productores para las entregas físicas del próximo año. * El cobre a tres meses en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres bajó un 0,4% hasta los 14.364 dólares por tonelada a las 1615 GMT, tras retroceder desde su máximo de tres semanas de 14.700 dólares alcanzado el 14 de octubre. * Datos publicados el miércoles revelaron que las existencias en la LME aumentaron en 11.475 toneladas, lo que supone un incremento del 8% en una semana. * Las existencias disponibles, es decir, aquellas no destinadas a ser retiradas de los almacenes, también han registrado fuertes alzas, con un incremento del 40% en el mismo periodo. * "A este nivel de precios, el cobre se sitúa muy por encima de donde debería estar, teniendo en cuenta las existencias mundiales", afirmó Alice Fox, analista de Macquarie, en una sesión informativa de la LME Week. "El año pasado tuvimos un gran excedente y creemos que habrá excedentes a nivel mundial durante los próximos años". * El contrato de cobre para noviembre más negociado en la Bolsa de Futuros de Shanghái cerró con una subida del 0,2% a 109.390 yuanes (16.379,43 dólares) por tonelada. * Aunque las existencias mundiales de cobre son elevadas, gran parte de ellas se encuentran en Estados Unidos, lo que provoca escasez regional en otros lugares, incluida Europa, donde los compradores se enfrentan a primas récord para 2027. * La chilena Codelco está ofreciendo a sus clientes una prima récord de 350 dólares por tonelada por encima del precio de la LME, según informaron fuentes a Reuters el martes. * El níquel fue el que mejor se comportó en la LME, con un repunte del 4,1% a 16.310 dólares por tonelada, su nivel más alto en más de tres semanas. * Entre otros metales básicos, el aluminio subió un 1,2% a 3.039 dólares por tonelada, el zinc subió un 0,5% a 3.742 dólares y el plomo ganó un 0,7% a 1.908 dólares, mientras que el estaño cayó un 0,5% a 51.090 dólares.

item.title: Cencora to buy American Oncology Network in $2.4 billion deal
item.description: Drug distributor Cencora said on Wednesday it would acquire American Oncology Network in a deal valuing the cancer care provider at up to $2.4 billion, deepening its reach in community oncology across the United States.
item.dc:creator: Sriparna Roy
item.content:encoded: Drug distributor Cencora (COR.N) said on Wednesday it would acquire American Oncology Network (AONC.PK) in a deal valuing the cancer care provider at up to $2.4 billion, deepening its reach in community oncology across the United States. Cencora, which currently owns about 4% of AON, will acquire all of the equity interests that it does not currently own. Its shares were down more than 1%. Community oncology practices, where physicians provide cancer care in outpatient settings, have become a dealmaking hotspot as demand for treatment outside hospital systems grows. In 2024, Cardinal Health (CAH.N) [USN:L4N3L215L TEXT:"agreed to acquire"] Integrated Oncology Network for $1.12 billion. Rival McKesson (MCK.N) acquired a [USN:L4N3KD0SP TEXT:"controlling interest"] in Core Ventures, the management services organization established by Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, for $2.49 billion, while Cencora in 2025 took majority [USN:L4N3XL0RW TEXT:"control"] of OneOncology in a $5 billion deal. Evercore ISI analyst Elizabeth Anderson said the deal diversifies Cencora's community oncology presence by adding AON's focus on smaller providers, compared to OneOncology's emphasis on larger practices. The AON deal consists of $2.3 billion payable at closing and contingent value rights worth up to $100 million tied to certain conditions. Certain AON shareholders may retain up to a 25% equity stake through a rollover arrangement, with Cencora expected to pay about $1.7 billion for a 75% stake. Cencora expects the acquisition to boost its adjusted profit per share in the second year after the deal closes. Barclays analyst Glen Santangelo said the deal's size suggests it is a continuation of the company's current strategy rather than anything transformational. Cencora also updated its annual forecast to reflect the strength of the US healthcare solutions reportable segment, ahead of its quarterly results on November 4. It expects adjusted per-share earnings to be at least $17.90, near the high end of the previous $17.75 to $17.95 range, while analysts estimate $17.89, according to data compiled by LSEG.

item.title: El Nino 'wrecking ball' could cause record Pacific temperature rise, UN says
item.description: The El Nino weather pattern could cause a record rise in ocean temperatures in the Pacific as it barrels around the globe like a "wrecking ball" causing floods and droughts, UN officials said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The [USN:L6N45F0NL TEXT:"El Nino weather pattern"] could cause a record rise in ocean temperatures in the Pacific as it barrels around the globe like a "wrecking ball" causing floods and droughts, UN officials said on Wednesday. The new World Meteorological Organization seasonal outlook predicted the El Nino event would become extremely strong, with temperatures in the central Pacific rising about 3.8 degrees Celsius above normal between November and January, peaking around December. "We have not seen in our records 3.8. We have seen around 3 in some record El Ninos before, with very substantive impacts across the world. So we are beyond that limit," WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo said. El Nino is the warm phase of the naturally occurring El Nino-Southern Oscillation cycle – a climate pattern that influences weather around the world. It tends to cause higher global temperatures and disrupt rainfall patterns across large regions, meaning drought in some areas and heavy rains in others. It is a natural climate pattern and is not caused by climate change. However, global warming can make El Ninos more intense. El Nino-linked weather extremes could worsen pressure on housing, water, sanitation and health services, with flooding risks rising in southern Africa from November, the WMO said. In Southeast Asia, warmer conditions and a lack of rainfall could impact agriculture and water supplies, while Latin America could see increased rainfall, according to the WMO. The WMO and the UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator, Tom Fletcher, called for urgent action to get ready. "This El Nino is the behemoth, it is a wrecking ball. It will tear through Latin America, Eastern and Southern Africa, Asia and the Pacific with extreme heat, droughts and flood," Fletcher said, warning of massive humanitarian consequences. Some 50 million people could face increased hunger, he said.

item.title: Abbott cuts 2026 sales growth view, plans to spin off nutrition business
item.description: Abbott Laboratories cut its 2026 sales growth forecast on Wednesday and said it plans to separate its nutrition business into a publicly traded company, amid costly litigation over its baby formula products.
item.dc:creator: Padmanabhan Ananthan, Christy Santhosh
item.content:encoded: Abbott Laboratories (ABT.N) cut its 2026 sales growth forecast on Wednesday and said it plans to separate its nutrition business into a publicly traded company, amid costly litigation over its baby formula products. The separation will shed a beleaguered unit behind brands such as Similac infant formula and Ensure nutritional drinks, which generated more than $8 billion in sales last year. Abbott joins peers, including Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) and Medtronic (MDT.N) , that have also announced business separations in recent years, as large healthcare companies reshape portfolios to sharpen focus on higher-growth segments. The nutrition division lost a major US government supply contract last year and faced higher manufacturing costs that prompted price increases and hurt demand. The baby formula business has faced a series of setbacks since a 2022 recall and shutdown of Abbott's Sturgis, Michigan, plant that exacerbated a nationwide shortage. The company also faced [USN:L4N44H1JN TEXT:"lawsuits"] alleging its specialized formula for premature infants caused a potentially fatal bowel disease. CEO Robert Ford struck an upbeat tone on a post-earnings call, and said outstanding legal disputes were unlikely to delay the separation. "Strategically, over the next decade, there's going to be a lot of segments in this nutrition business ... that are going to be very differentiated and kind of high growth." The company expects the separation to be complete in 2027. Abbott shares fell 4% in morning trading. The slip was likely due to the "potential for nutrition value creation partially offsetting the moderated underlying business fundamentals," J.P.Morgan analyst Robbie Marcus said. REDUCED FORECAST WEIGHS ON 2027 Abbott now expects 2026 sales growth of about 6%, down from its prior expectation of 6.5% to 7.5%. It tightened its full-year adjusted profit per share forecast range to $5.50 to $5.55 from $5.45 to $5.60. This was unfavorable to the extent of affecting the company's 2027 trajectory, RBC Capital Markets analyst Au Kendall said. Third-quarter adjusted profit of $1.42 per share was in line with estimates. Revenue came in at $13.01 billion. Analysts on average estimated $13 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.

Oct 21 : Estonian ride-hailing platform Bolt is launching an autonomous driving programme in Madrid during 2027 and aims to expand into Western European cities before the end of the year, the company said on Wednesday. The programme is set to deploy Nvidia's Alpamayo software in at least 25,000 vehicles manufactured by Lucid as Spain moves to issue permits for testing autonomous vehicles on public roads. • Bolt told Reuters the programme in Madrid is a starting point for gathering real-world data and expects "tens of vehicles" on the streets of the Spanish capital next year • Madrid will be the pilot city because the region has created a testing permit allowing limited commercial operations without full approval, Bolt's head of autonomous driving Jevgeni Kabanov said

item.title: ロシアの米国向け軽油タンカー第1便、22日出航＝副首相
item.description: [モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] - ロシアのノバク副首相は２１日、トランプ米大統領との軽油供給合意を受け、米国向け軽油を積んだ最初のタンカーが２２日に出航すると明らかにした。現地紙ベドモスチが報じた。

報道によると、ノバク氏はタンカーに軽油４万トンを積み込むと述べ、供給に関する書類の手続きも完了が近いと説明した。積み出し港は明らかにしなかった。

ロシア通信（ＲＩＡ）によると、ノバク氏は「当然追加の出荷も続く。両首脳の間で合意が成立している。可能な範囲で米国の需要に応える」と述べた。

トランプ氏はこれまでに、ロシアが直ちに３０万トン（２２５万バレル）を輸出し、１１月に５０万トン、「その直後」に１００万トンを輸出すると説明している。

プーチン大統領は２１日、サンクトペテルブルクで米国のウィットコフ中東担当特使と会談した。ウィットコフ氏はロシアが９日に軽油の輸出禁止を解除したことに謝意を示した。プーチン氏も軽油輸出合意に言及し、合意後に世界の軽油価格が５─６％下落したと述べた。

ウィットコフ氏はテレビで放映された発言で「これはわれわれが協力している一例だ。そのことに感謝したい」と述べた。

プーチン氏は軽油を積んだロシアの最初のタンカーが２─３日後に出港するとの見通しを示した。「現在、数隻のタンカーによる輸送を準備している。順次出港する。資金面の手当てが必要だ」と語った。またロシアは米国市場に肥料を「大量に」供給することも可能だと述べた。

item.title: テラドローンの無人機販売「敵対的」、厳しい対応取る＝ロ外務省
item.description: [モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] - ロシア外務省は２１日、日本企業のテラドローンによるウクライナへのドローン（無人機）販売を「敵対的」な取引と見なすと表明し、厳しい対応を取ると警告した。

ザハロワ報道官は、テラドローンが先週、ウクライナにドローンを納入したと発表したことに対応していると説明。定例記者会見で「テラドローンがウクライナ軍と協力していることは単なる『民間主導の取り組み』に過ぎないとして、これを正当化しようとする日本当局の試みは全く説得力に欠ける」と述べた。

item.description: Russia lifted its self-imposed ban on diesel exports on Oct 9, introduced to tackle domestic shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries, after reaching the deal with US President Donald Trump to supply diesel to global markets.

Russia says it will send first diesel cargo to US on Thursday

MOSCOW: Russia will dispatch its first tanker with diesel for the United States on Thursday (Oct 22), Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said, according to the Vedomosti news outlet, after a deal with US President Donald Trump. Russia lifted its self-imposed ban on diesel exports on Oct 9, introduced to tackle domestic shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries, after reaching the deal with Trump to supply diesel to global markets. Novak said on Wednesday the vessel will carry 40,000 metric tons of the fuel, adding that the paperwork on the fuel supply is nearing its completion, according to media reports. He did not name the port from which the cargo will be delivered. "Additional shipments will follow, of course. There were agreements reached between the two leaders. We will meet the United States' needs, to the extent of our capabilities," RIA news agency quoted Novak as saying.

Trump has said Russia would immediately export 300,000 metric tons, or 2.25 million barrels, followed by 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons "immediately thereafter". The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day. Russian President Vladimir Putin was hosting US special envoy Steve Witkoff on Wednesday, after the US-Russia diesel export deal led to a sharp deterioration in ties between the United States and Ukraine. During the talks in St Petersburg, Witkoff thanked Putin for lifting the export restrictions. Putin also mentioned the deal, saying that global diesel prices dropped by 5 per cent to 6 per cent after the agreement. "That's an example of us working together, I want to thank you for that," Witkoff said in televised comments. Putin also said that first Russian tankers with diesel will departs in two to three days. "We are preparing deliveries of several vessels, the tankers, right now. They will go one after another. The financial component should be provided," he said, adding that Russia also would be able to supply fertilisers in "large quantities" to the US market.

Oct 21 : Self-driving truck company Einride said on Wednesday it would broaden its partnership with Nvidia by testing the chipmaker's AI reasoning model, Alpamayo, in its self-driving vehicles, aiming to speed up the expansion of autonomous freight services while lowering development costs. Alpamayo is Nvidia's vision language action model, which can interpret driving environments, recommend vehicle actions and explain its reasoning. • The Swedish company said it plans to become the first trucking operator to deploy Alpamayo, adapting the model using data collected from its commercial freight operations • Einride said the technology could help shorten development cycles and make it easier to extend autonomous driving capabilities to new vehicle types and routes, with a live road evaluation planned for the second half of 2027
